Narrator

rows.notes: placeholder row ([jp] = the narrator)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kanji
%4■Full Name■%1
Kanji Akatsuki
%4■Profile■%1
> The son of Kyo Akatsuki, who is known as a legendary GT pilot. His reflexes are outstanding, but he is hopeless at schoolwork.
> Unlike his earnest, upright father, he is easygoing and optimistic.
> He knows how to get along in the world and has many close friends.
> As a pilot he is head and shoulders above the rest, with an intuitive feel for the controls inherited from his father.
> Having been picked as the FT test pilot, he is also deeply involved in developing the production models.
> His many achievements, including real combat, have earned him a place among the top active pilots. He himself, however, does not seem to realize it.
{x00}
rows.notes: Reused the approved model translation unchanged.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Lun
%4■Full Name■%1
Lun Forest
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl Kanji met by chance on the battlefield.
> She has a deep love of nature.
> Her origins are shrouded in mystery; she herself remembers almost nothing, especially about her early childhood.
> Yet she is so cheerful and gentle that you would never suspect it.
> She dislikes conflict but has a strong core, and at times shows the courage to throw herself into danger for her friends.
> She is also someone who truly understands Kanji and the others, who get dragged into battles they never wanted.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Rie
%4■Full Name■%1
Rie Akatsuki
%4■Profile■%1
> Kanji Akatsuki's younger sister.
> She has looked after her brother and father for as long as she can remember, which has made her caring toward everyone.
> Unusually for the Akatsuki family, she is hopeless at sports.
> She tries every day, with touching effort, to make up for it, but...
> On the other hand, she is so good at studying that she earned a doctorate at 16.
> Rie, whose research subject was the relationship between the Cloud Stream phenomenon and the ecosystem, volunteered for the Sea of Clouds survey team aboard the survey ship "Astante," finally built after much trial and error.
> Because the survey team was a research body funded by the military, Rie also trained as an officer cadet.
> Her grades were excellent in everything except basic physical ability, so she joined the Sea of Clouds survey team as she had hoped. But when a war suddenly engulfed her and the situation worsened, she was made captain more or less by force of circumstance and ended up commanding many battles.
> Valued for that experience, she was also appointed captain of the "Astante II," the first battleship equipped with the Cloud System, and so began her career as a commander in earnest.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source paragraph 'sono keiken wo kawareta kanojo wa, ' has a stray trailing space; ignored. | [editorial] smoothed stiff literal ending (honkakuteki ni shireikan no michi)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Nelfea
%4■Full Name■%1
Nelfea Northrock
%4■Profile■%1
> A female pilot who looks up to Professor Hakuto Rondo as her uncle and has been schooled under his guidance.
> She is brilliant and a superb athlete.
> Though still young enough to be called a girl, she has cool judgment and keen insight.
> Because of that, she sometimes speaks and acts in ways that could be taken for overconfidence, but in real combat she never overrates her own strength to the point of losing sight of the situation and charging out ahead.
> Her abilities are beyond reproach, but on the other hand she is poor at dealing with people.
> Before meeting Kanji, she was Professor Rondo's capable assistant and test pilot, supporting his research.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'Oji to shitai' kept as 'looks up to ... as her uncle': the text does not say whether he is her actual uncle. Reading in parentheses (kuntou) dropped. | [editorial] clarity: negated chain read as three separate denials; causal chain made explicit

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kyo
%4■Full Name■%1
Kyo Akatsuki
%4■Profile■%1
> The father of Kanji and Rie.
> He is one of the heroes who made their name as GT pilots in the Third Claudian War.
> During that war he belonged to the Cloud Alliance Forces, and the results he achieved in the Gunblaze, developed by those forces, were tremendous.
> Within those forces Kyo's piloting skill was head and shoulders above the rest, and it was said that no one could match him.
> He now holds the post of commander of an army, but his skills have not dulled in the least. While devoting himself to training young pilots, he also works hard to clean up the military.
> He is earnest and upright by nature.
> He is a strict father to his son and daughter, but generous toward others, who place deep trust in him.
> When it comes to housework, however, he is as sloppy and careless as Kanji, so he depends entirely on his daughter to look after him.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Daisanji Kuraudia Taisen -> 'Third Claudia War'; Kuraudo Doumei-gun -> 'Cloud Alliance Forces'; Ganbureizu -> 'Gunblaze'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rondo
%4■Full Name■%1
Hakuto Rondo
%4■Profile■%1
> One of the heroes who made their name in the Third Claudian War.
> In that war he and Kyo Akatsuki were enemies and often exchanged fire.
> An honest man who will not tolerate wrongdoing, he became close friends with the upright Kyo Akatsuki after the war.
> Besides being an excellent pilot, he is also a central figure in GT and FT development.
> No account of the Cloud Ship's successful development would be complete without him.
{x00}
rows.notes: Kuraudoshippu -> 'Cloud Ship' (not in glossary). | [editorial] literal "cannot be told without" smoothed to natural reference English

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Tail
%4■Full Name■%1
Tail Kinui
%4■Profile■%1
> An excellent pilot who served as Kyo Akatsuki's support in the Third Claudian War.
> She specializes in support attacks from the rear.
> She now commands and runs a fleet, where she shows her skill to the full.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source uses no pronoun; 'she' from glossary gender (female).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Omega
%4■Full Name■%1
Omega Fokurosu
%4■Profile■%1
> A young pilot of unknown background whose skill stands out even among the elite Redros Army pilots trained by Binzvanker himself.
> He is known for never losing his composure even in extreme situations, and for never making a piloting error.
> Understanding the ideals of the Redros Army and able to make decisions from a strategic standpoint, he is often entrusted with command of independent units.
> He also enjoys the deep trust of Supreme Commander Binzvanker, and is always at the core of the Redros Army's operational planning.
> In name and in fact, he wields great influence within the army.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] stiff idiom smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Binzvanker
%4■Full Name■%1
Redros Binzvanker
%4■Profile■%1
> A commander famed in the Third Claudian War as the bravest general of the Cloud Alliance Forces.
> He once served as adjutant of the Second Army, the largest of the Alliance Forces, and drew up many brilliant operations -- so much so that he was even said to be its real commander.
> After the war he took complete control of the Second Army and became a central figure in a shadow organization that manipulated the military-industrial complex.
> Thanks to the efforts of Kyo Akatsuki and others, the organization's wrongdoing was exposed, but under various pressures the affair was hardly ever made public.
> Moreover, his record in the old war was tremendous, and many soldiers owed their lives to his operations. As a result, many in the Claudian Unified Forces still idolize him, and at the time of the coup many soldiers came under the Redros Army's banner.
{x00}
rows.notes: Kuraudia Tougou-gun -> 'Claudian Unified Forces' (from glossary soldier/officer entries).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Amuro
%4■Full Name■%1
Amuro Ray
%4■Profile■%1
> The Earth Federation Forces hero who, at the tender age of 15, piloted the RX-78 Gundam and achieved unrivaled results in the "One Year War," the conflict between the Earth Federation Forces and the forces of the Principality of Zeon that killed about half of humanity.
> First-rate both as a pilot and as an engineer, he is considered an NT (Newtype) because of his abnormally fast reactions.
> NT is a concept born of the idea that humans who move out into space will expand their powers of perception to match, becoming able to understand one another across space; the military, however, regards them as pilots with ESP-like powers.
> For that reason, after the One Year War he was shunned by the Federation top brass, who see NTs as dangerous, and kept in confinement.
> Even so, when the Titans were founded within the Earth Federation Forces and tried to oppress space emigrants, he slipped through the military's surveillance net and fought alongside the AEUG, the organization that opposed them.
> After that he joined Londo Bell, an auxiliary organization of the Earth Federation Forces, and to prevent another war he kept touring the colonies, watching to make sure anti-Federation sentiment did not erupt.
> However, Londo Bell, with only a small staff, cannot possibly monitor every colony, and his anxiety only grows.
> He seems quiet and gentle at first glance, but like the seasoned warrior he is, he also has a cool, bold side.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] 'ijou na made no hannou sokudo': 'almost' was an added hedge; reactions are abnormally fast

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Chan
%4■Full Name■%1
Chan Agi
%4■Profile■%1
> A woman who is a technical officer with Londo Bell and also works as a mechanic.
> She is unpretentious and straightforward, and has a single-minded, active side too: she runs around working to complete the Nu Gundam, whose basic design was done by Amuro, the man she has feelings for, and which he pilots himself.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Bright
%4■Full Name■%1
Bright Noa
%4■Profile■%1
> A highly capable Earth Federation Forces captain who has kept fighting on the front lines of every battlefield since the days of the "One Year War."
> However, having always achieved his results while leading people regarded as NTs (Newtypes), he is shunned by the top brass, who see NTs as dangerous, and is treated far worse than his achievements would suggest.
> Even in a position where he is effectively isolated and without support, he keeps fighting for the innocent people living in the Earth Sphere -- a man with a strong sense of justice and responsibility.
> In his private life, after the "One Year War" he married Mirai Yashima, the White Base's helmsman, who went through hardship alongside him.
> With her he has two children, his son Hathaway and his daughter Cheimin, and although work keeps him from seeing them often, he has built a happy family.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Mirai Yashima, Cheimin (official English spellings). | [editorial] doubled "eldest" reads oddly with only two children

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hathaway
%4■Full Name■%1
Hathaway Noa
%4■Profile■%1
> The eldest son of Bright and Mirai.
> He grew up on Earth among a strong father, a gentle mother and an adorable little sister.
> Though honest and innocent by nature, he seems to have courage as well -- perhaps it is Bright's blood.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Kayra
%4■Full Name■%1
Kayra Su
%4■Profile■%1
> A female pilot assigned to the Londo Bell unit.
> Her rank is lieutenant junior grade.
> Tomboyish and spirited, she is deeply trusted by her comrades.
> A pilot of sure skill, she sometimes even takes command of the combat squad when Amuro is away.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Char
%4■Full Name■%1
Char Aznable
%4■Real Name■%1
Casval Rem Deikun
%4■Profile■%1
> Supreme Leader of the Neo Zeon forces.
> His real name is Casval Rem Deikun, and he is the eldest son of Zeon Zum Deikun, the leader who once advocated the independence of space citizens and the evolution of humanity that had gone out into space.
> However, his father was assassinated by the Zabi family at the end of a political struggle.
> Once grown, he hid his true identity and joined the forces of the Principality of Zeon for revenge, achieving results that earned him the nickname "Red Comet."
> He accomplished that goal amid the chaos of the war, but in the course of the fighting he met a Newtype girl named Lalah Sune and awakened to a new goal: building a world through Newtypes.
> Later, calling himself Quattro Bajeena, he infiltrated the Earth Federation and the AEUG, but there he saw the state of the Earth Federation government and despaired at how corrupt it was.
> From that experience, the idealist in him founded Neo Zeon with firm conviction to purge "the people whose souls are bound by Earth's gravity," and took action.
> Inwardly, however, he is tormented by the weight of carrying on the name of his father Zeon Zum Deikun and remaining a hero, and his heart still longs for the warmth of Lalah, whom he lost in his battles with his archrival Amuro.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label: honmyou -> 'Real Name'. Not in glossary: Casval Rem Deikun, Zeon Zum Deikun, Zabi family, Lalah Sune, Principality of Zeon. 'Kakushin' rendered 'evolution' (of humanity).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Nanai
%4■Full Name■%1
Nanai Miguel
%4■Profile■%1
> A female Neo Zeon officer.
> A capable tactical officer, she also serves as director of the Newtype Laboratory.
> She is also something like Char's secretary, supporting him in both public and private matters.
> Personally, too, she has feelings for Char, and it frustrates her that he is still haunted by the phantom of Lalah Sune, whom he lost in the "One Year War."
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Gyunei
%4■Full Name■%1
Gyunei Guss
%4■Profile■%1
> A cyber-Newtype from the Neo Zeon Newtype Laboratory.
> A cyber-Newtype is a person given artificial Newtype-like abilities through drugs and other means, but as the price of those abilities they have flaws such as mental instability.
> He lost his parents when colonies were destroyed during the One Year War, and seeking enough power to keep that tragedy from happening again, he volunteered for enhancement at the Newtype Laboratory.
> He did so fully aware that he would be treated like a lab animal, with researchers tampering not only with his body but even with his mind.
> Then again, even that memory may have been manufactured...
> He does not necessarily agree with Char's methods; he intends to be the force that stops Char should his revolution go too far, and if the chance ever comes, he aims to take Char's place himself.
> He is a young, ambitious man.
{x00}
rows.notes: Kyouka ningen -> 'Cyber-Newtype' (not in glossary; used throughout the slice). 'Koronii tsubushi' rendered 'when colonies were destroyed' (literal sense kept, no specific event named).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rezin
%4■Full Name■%1
Rezin Schnyder
%4■Profile■%1
> A Neo Zeon ensign who leads a Geara Doga platoon -- a formidable, battle-hardened woman.
> One of the most skilled pilots, she has absolute confidence in her own combat ability.
> A typical old-school warrior with a bold personality, she hates seeing youngsters throw their weight around on the battlefield just because they are Newtypes or cyber-Newtypes.
{x00}
rows.notes: Ranks follow glossary positions: shoui ensign, chuui lieutenant, shousa major, chuusa commander, taisa captain, chuujou lieutenant general. | [editorial] awkward "veteran woman" phrasing reordered; joketsu kept as "formidable woman" (as Cima); adjective pile smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Lyle
%4■Profile■%1
> A Neo Zeon lieutenant colonel serving under Char Aznable.
> Captain of the Rewloola, the Neo Zeon flagship, and an excellent officer who always reads the battle situation calmly and coolly.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronoun used (gender not given in source or glossary). Rewloola: glossary entry has no English; official spelling used. | [editorial] chuusa = Lieutenant Colonel (late decision 2026-11-01; resolves accuracy flag)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Quess
%4■Full Name■%1
Quess Paraya
%4■Profile■%1
> The only daughter of Adenauer Paraya, Vice Chief of Staff of the Earth Federation Forces.
> Very pure-hearted, she senses human ego in her selfish father, and becomes interested in NTs (Newtypes), through whom people could understand each other heart to heart.
> She herself has a high aptitude for NT abilities, and perhaps because she intuitively grasps the true nature of people and things, she cannot control her emotions in the face of complicated adult circumstances and throws tantrums, which sometimes makes her look selfish to those around her.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Adenauer Paraya. 'Sanbou jikan' rendered 'Deputy Chief of Staff'. | [accuracy] project decision: sanbou jikan = Vice Chief of Staff

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Cameron
%4■Full Name■%1
Cameron Bloom
%4■Profile■%1
> A man who works at the Accounting Audit Bureau in Londenion.
> A serious, kind person.
> He was once the fiance of Mirai, now Mrs. Bright Noa.
> His feelings for her have not changed even now, and he quietly prays from afar that she will live happily.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Londenion.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kamille
%4■Full Name■%1
Kamille Bidan
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy with a complex about his parents, who neglect their family, and about his girlish name and looks.
> In reaction, he took up karate, Junior Mobile Suit piloting and the like, trying to toughen himself into a man.
> The Gundam Mk-II was being developed in the colony where he lived, and getting caught up in its theft led him to join the AEUG.
> Recognized as having the makings of a pilot, he went on to blossom in the AEUG.
> But having gone to war with no ideas of his own -- driven only by resentment toward his parents and the Titans, and swept along by events -- he has not managed to change his gloomy situation here either.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Quattro
%4■Full Name■%1
Quattro Bajeena
%4■Real Name■%1
Casval Rem Deikun
%4■Profile■%1
> The false identity that Char Aznable, who was called the "Red Comet" after achieving astonishing results in the "One Year War," uses to infiltrate the Federation Forces.
> The name Quattro means "4" in Italian.
> This apparently comes from it being the fourth name of his life, after his real name Casval; Edouard, which he used to hide from the Zabi family after his father Zeon was assassinated; and Char, which he used when he joined the Zeon forces to bring down the Zabis.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Edouard (Edowau). | [editorial] awkward passive with displaced agent rewritten

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Emma
%4■Full Name■%1
Emma Sheen
%4■Profile■%1
> Originally a member of the Titans, she came to question their actions and threw in her lot with the AEUG, the organization that opposes them.
> She was a particularly good pilot even within the Titans, regarded as the Earth Federation Forces' elite unit, so her skill itself is solid, but she sometimes lets theory run ahead of her or overestimates her own ability.
> She often speaks and acts harshly, but in her own way she does so with the other person's good in mind.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] dangling modifier fixed; "sure" -> "solid"

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Henken
%4■Full Name■%1
Henken Bekkener
%4■Profile■%1
> An Earth Federation Forces serviceman who sympathized with the AEUG's ideals and joined its activities.
> Cheerful and bold, he is a capable commander who can think flexibly, outside the usual mold.
> In private, however, he is shy and tongue-tied, with an innocent side that makes it hard for him to confess his feelings to a woman.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Kai
%4■Full Name■%1
Kai Shiden
%4■Profile■%1
> A pilot who served on the White Base in the One Year War and fought alongside Amuro and the others.
> He now works as a freelance journalist.
> He is as sarcastic as ever, but his old weakness has faded, and he stands on his own feet as an adult.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Jerid
%4■Full Name■%1
Jerid Messa
%4■Profile■%1
> A pilot of outstanding ability even among the Titans.
> However, perhaps because he is proud and prone to getting emotional, he keeps losing over and over to Kamille, whom he became involved with by a fluke.
> On top of that, the people dear to him were defeated by Kamille and killed one after another, so his grudge keeps growing, and his outlook has narrowed even further.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Mouar
%4■Full Name■%1
Mouar Pharaoh
%4■Profile■%1
> A beautiful woman who met Jerid at Jaburo and has been his partner ever since.
> Not only is her MS piloting skill solid, she is also an excellent pilot who stays calm and judges things correctly.
> She has found hope for the future in Jerid, and protecting him has become her own hope, the thing she acts for.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Jaburo. | [editorial] awkward "piloting sure" smoothed; ungrammatical "acts with protecting him as her hope" smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Yazan
%4■Full Name■%1
Yazan Gable
%4■Profile■%1
> A Titans pilot.
> An arrogant, insolent man who seems to fight for the thrill of combat.
> His MS piloting skill is first-class, but his conduct leaves much to be desired: he tries to eliminate anyone he dislikes, friend or foe, even if it is his own superior.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Four
%4■Full Name■%1
Four Murasame
%4■Real Name■%1
Unknown
%4■Profile■%1
> A cyber-Newtype girl created at the Murasame Institute, a Newtype research facility in Japan.
> A cyber-Newtype is an NT (Newtype) created artificially through drugs and other means; they have NT-like abilities, but also flaws such as mental instability.
> All her memories from before she entered the institute are lost, and even the name Four was merely given to her because she was the fourth test subject at the Murasame Institute.
> Because of that, she is forced to fight at the institute's bidding, on its promise to give her memories back.
> She herself may have sensed that the promise was probably a lie, but she had no other choice.
> After meeting Kamille, she wavers between her obsession with recovering her memories and her wish to be with him, but gradually she comes to choose the future over the past...
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Murasame Institute.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Scirocco
%4■Full Name■%1
Paptimus Scirocco
%4■Profile■%1
> A man of many mysteries who joined the Titans as captain of the Jupitris, a gigantic transport ship that carries deuterium from Jupiter.
> He appears to have been born and raised aboard the Jupitris while it was at Jupiter, and almost no records about him exist.
> His abilities are astonishing: not only is he top-class as both a pilot and a tactician, he even has the outstanding technical skill to build many high-performance handmade MS. There is no other word for him but genius.
> He himself is aware that he is a genius, and despises those without talent.
> He is composed and coldhearted by nature, but this seems to stem from a lack of human feeling, somehow detached from the world, as if he were watching everything from far away.
> He says that once the turmoil is over, women should rule the Earth, but his true intentions are unfathomable.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Jupitris.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Bask
%4■Full Name■%1
Bask Om
%4■Profile■%1
> An officer entrusted with command of the Titans' combat forces.
> A forceful, self-righteous man who will use any means to achieve his goals.
> He holds the elitist belief that the Titans, made up solely of Earth-born elites, are the "chosen people" meant to lead humanity.
> He mistakenly believes that the Titans can do no wrong, and that whatever the Titans do is by definition justice.
> Born on Earth, he was prejudiced against Spacenoids to begin with, and when he was taken prisoner by Zeon during the "One Year War," he was tortured and his eyes were damaged, which deepened his hatred of Spacenoids.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Spacenoid. | [editorial] wrong/wrong repetition

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Jamitov
%4■Full Name■%1
Jamitov Hymem
%4■Profile■%1
> The man who proposed founding the Titans, an organization within the Earth Federation Forces whose purpose is to hunt down Zeon remnants, and its Supreme Leader.
> Not a battlefield commander but a schemer, he is better at using his political power from the rear to shape situations than at standing on the front line.
> The Titans' original purpose is to find and root out remnants of the former Zeon forces, and to prevent and suppress colony riots.
> But their activities do not stop there: anyone they judge to be a malcontent against the Earth Federation is mercilessly oppressed, and such people's activities are crushed by any means necessary.
> His true goal is to wipe out the Spacenoids, then reduce Earth's population too, and afterward restore the Earth under the Titans' management.
> In short, the Titans' cause is management of the Earth Sphere by chosen people -- the very thing that Gihren Zabi, Supreme Leader of the Principality of Zeon, once advocated, which could well be called a laughable paradox.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Gihren Zabi. | [accuracy] referent clarified (the malcontents' activities are crushed, not the Titans'); hedge 'to ieyou' restored | [editorial] stiff opening restructured into reference form

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Haman
%4■Full Name■%1
Haman Karn
%4■Profile■%1
> The woman who effectively leads Axis as guardian and regent for Mineva Lao Zabi, the orphaned child of the Zabi family that once ruled the former Principality of Zeon.
> She is capable both as a battle commander and as an administrator, and is also an extremely skilled pilot with Newtype abilities.
> She does not trust others much and intensely hates having anyone get inside her heart, apparently because she feels betrayed by Char, whom she trusted and loved.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] 'kyokutan ni' (intensely) restored

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mineva
%4■Full Name■%1
Mineva Lao Zabi
%4■Profile■%1
> The child left behind by Lieutenant General Dozle Zabi, a member of the Zabi family, rulers of the Principality of Zeon, who was killed in defeat in the "One Year War."
> As the sole survivor of the Zabi family and heir to its right to rule, she is held up by Haman Karn as the symbol of Axis.
> However, because of the skewed education she received to make her fit that position, she has become Haman's puppet.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Dozle Zabi.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ple
%4■Full Name■%1
Elpeo Ple
%4■Profile■%1
> An innocent, lively, energetic girl from Axis.
> Only ten, she is nonetheless a pilot with strong Newtype abilities.
> However, to her, fighting is still nothing more than a game or a way to express her feelings, and she does not understand what it really means.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Mashymre
%4■Full Name■%1
Mashymre Cello
%4■Profile■%1
> A sincere knight who worships Haman Karn and has sworn absolute loyalty to her.
> He is a young officer who values chivalry and is always earnest and serious, but he often tries too hard and ends up spinning his wheels.
> He has talent and spares no effort, but his vain, show-off personality gets in the way and he rarely manages to show his true ability.
{x00}
rows.notes: [proofread] grammar: noun-phrase fragment joined to a 'but he...' clause; subject 'He is' supplied

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kou
%4■Full Name■%1
Kou Uraki
%4■Profile■%1
> An Earth Federation Forces ensign.
> A capable pilot who is good with machines and handles them with real understanding.
> He and Chuck Keith have been best friends since their days at the Nijmegen officer academy, nicknamed the "rich boys' school."
> Originally a test pilot at Torrington Base in Australia, which is strongly geared toward experiments and training, he was drawn into the fight against the Delaz Fleet after he boarded Gundam Unit 1 to chase Unit 2 when it was stolen.
> He is earnest and fastidious, with a strong sense of responsibility and justice.
> At first, perhaps because of his good upbringing, he was a delicate young man who had not shed his boyish nature, but he grows tougher through real combat.
> He hates carrots.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Nijmegen (Naimehen), Torrington Base, Delaz Fleet. 'Keppekishou' rendered 'fastidious'. | [editorial] clunky fragment smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Nina
%4■Full Name■%1
Nina Purpleton
%4■Profile■%1
> A systems engineer at AE (Anaheim Electronics).
> As the person in charge of system software for the GP series, developed under the "Gundam Development Project," she came down to Earth to test the performance of Units 1 and 2 under gravity.
> There, she ran into the theft of Unit 2 and was drawn into the fight against the Delaz Fleet.
> A Lunarian, born and raised on the Moon.
> Proud by nature, she had poured an abnormally intense love into the Gundams she was helping to develop, but she is gradually drawn to Kou.
{x00}
rows.notes: Gender not stated in source or glossary, so no pronouns used; the name is repeated instead. 'Jira ga kaihatsu ni tazusawatte iru' condensed to 'the Gundams under development' (Nina's involvement is implied by the previous lines). Not in glossary: Lunarian, Gundam Development Project. | [accuracy] 'mizukara ga kaihatsu ni tazusawatte iru' (her own involvement) restored; 'almost' was an added hedge; glossary gives Nina Purpleton as female | [editorial] glossary gives Nina as female: name-repetition workaround smoothed; pronoun smoothing (Nina f); pronoun smoothing (Nina f)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Keith
%4■Full Name■%1
Chuck Keith
%4■Profile■%1
> An Earth Federation Forces ensign.
> Kou's best friend and a fellow test pilot.
> In contrast to Kou, he is a cheerful, frivolous joker, and smooth with women too.
> He is quite careless by nature, but he has a manly side as well: when Kou volunteered for the operation to recapture Gundam Unit 2, he volunteered as well to go with him, despite the danger.
> His skill as a pilot is quite good, but he is somehow unreliable and is having trouble getting used to real combat.
{x00}
rows.notes: Glossary has no gender; 'he' based on 'otokorashii' (manly) and context. | [editorial] awkward "volunteered too to go along"

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mora
%4■Full Name■%1
Mora Bascht
%4■Profile■%1
> A big, spirited woman with a bold personality.
> She is the chief mechanic of the assault landing ship Albion.
> Originally at Jaburo, she was transferred to the Albion for the "Gundam Development Project."
> Big-sisterly and caring, she gives advice to Kou and Nina, who are having a hard time getting used to things.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'Nakanaka narenai Kou to Nina' is vague (used to what?); kept as 'getting used to things'. | [editorial] word order ("chief mechanic", as glossary position)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Synapse
%4■Full Name■%1
Eiphar Synapse
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of the assault landing ship Albion, with the rank of colonel in the Earth Federation Forces.
> Bold and decisive, strict yet capable of flexible thinking -- an excellent commander.
> However, though capable, Synapse is so stubborn about never bending on principle that it backfires, leaving few allies among the military leadership.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns (gender not given in source or glossary). | [accuracy] taisa = Colonel (project decision; old 'captain' rank stale)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kowen
%4■Full Name■%1
John Kowen
%4■Profile■%1
> An Earth Federation Forces lieutenant general.
> Head of the "Gundam Development Project," which aims to build "the strongest mobile suit" and is one part of the plan to rebuild the Earth Federation Forces, still worn out from the last war, the "One Year War."
> One of the few voices of good sense at Jaburo who are concerned about the state of the Earth Federation Forces.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns (gender not given in source or glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Nakato
%4■Full Name■%1
Nakaha Nakato
%4■Profile■%1
> A major and leader of the 401st Patrol Squadron, stationed on the La Vie en Rose, a giant dock ship owned by AE (Anaheim Electronics).
> Obedient to those above and arrogant to those below, and inflexible to boot -- a typical military bureaucrat.
> An officer under the sway of Jamitov and other top brass, he is a sneaky, despicable man.
{x00}
rows.notes: La Vie en Rose: glossary entry has no English; official spelling used. 'Keikai chuutai' rendered 'Patrol Squadron' (glossary position note). | [editorial] rank clause dangled after AE; moved up front

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Delaz
%4■Full Name■%1
Aiguille Delaz
%4■Profile■%1
> The general who leads the remnants of the former Zeon forces that call themselves the "Delaz Fleet" and have declared war on the Earth Federation Forces.
> A resolute figure of great vision and drive who plans and directs "Operation Stardust."
> In the "One Year War," he was a brave general who fought under Gihren Zabi, whom he revered. After Gihren was assassinated by his sister Kycilia, Delaz left the front lines to carry on his will, lying low and building up strength while waiting for the right moment.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns for Delaz (gender not given in source or glossary). Not in glossary: Operation Stardust, Kycilia. | [accuracy] 'suuhai suru' is Delaz's own reverence, not a general epithet; glossary gives Aiguille Delaz as male | [editorial] glossary gives Delaz as male: pronoun smoothing (name kept after Gihren for clarity)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gato
%4■Full Name■%1
Anavel Gato
%4■Profile■%1
> A veteran warrior devoted to Aiguille Delaz, he forms the core of Delaz's forces as his right-hand man in the quest to restore Zeon.
> In the "One Year War," he won fame as an ace pilot of the Space Attack Force under Lieutenant General Dozle Zabi, and was feared as the "Nightmare of Solomon."
> A fastidious, old-fashioned man who values honor, he despises the feeble Federation Forces.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Space Attack Force, Nightmare of Solomon. | [editorial] "who" could attach to Delaz; clumsy double "as" smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Karius
%4■Profile■%1
> A Zeon pilot who serves under Gato and has his full trust.
> Holds the rank of sergeant, with skill that can fairly be called first-class.
> Also one of the few survivors of the 302nd Patrol Squadron that Gato led in the "One Year War."
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns for Karius (gender not given in source or glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Cima
%4■Full Name■%1
Cima Garahau
%4■Profile■%1
> A formidable woman who leads the Zeon Marine fleet commonly called the Cima Fleet, and who is herself an outstanding MS pilot.
> Her rank is lieutenant colonel.
> In the "One Year War" she was often made to do the dirty work, so she harbors complicated feelings toward Gato and the other elites who operated close to the Zabi family in the homeland, even though they are fellow Zeon.
> After the war she turned to space piracy to survive, but she answered Aiguille Delaz's call and joined with the fleet under her command.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source rank is chuusa -> 'commander'; glossary position says 'lt. commander'. Flag for review. | [editorial] chuusa = Lieutenant Colonel (late decision; review_dialogue_draft queue: Cima)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kelley
%4■Full Name■%1
Kelley Layzner
%4■Profile■%1
> A comrade who fought alongside Gato at Solomon in the "One Year War."
> But he lost his left arm in that battle and was removed from duty as an MS pilot.
> Since the war he has run a junk shop in Von Braun on the Moon, but the fire of his pilot's soul still smolders within him, not yet extinguished.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Solomon, Von Braun.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Heero
%4■Full Name■%1
Heero Yuy
%4■Real Name■%1
Unknown
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy thoroughly trained to be a "perfect soldier" who acts solely to accomplish his mission.
> He has been taught not to be swayed by emotion and to eliminate anything that gets in the way of his mission.
> Always calm and composed, he makes decisions based only on achieving his objective, which gives others a cold impression.
> However, through meeting Relena and the other Gundam pilots, he gradually regains the kind, caring, human feelings that are his true nature.
> "Heero Yuy" is not his real name but a code name, taken from the name of a leader who once advocated disarmament and nonviolence in seeking autonomy for the colonies, and was assassinated.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Duo
%4■Full Name■%1
Duo Maxwell
%4■Real Name■%1
Unknown
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy who "may run and hide, but never lies."
> A "cheerful God of Death" raised as a combat and sabotage professional by an organization called the "Sweeper Group."
> No one who has seen him on the battlefield has come back alive.
> He is an orphan, but bright, sociable and a positive thinker.
> Even in adversity he may bemoan his lot, but he has the strong will never to let it get him down.
> He seems flippant, but he is surprisingly diligent, never cutting corners even on dull work and doing it properly.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Sweeper Group. | [accuracy] 'nageki wa shite mo': lament, not grumble (weakened); shinigami = 'God of Death' (project decision)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Trowa
%4■Full Name■%1
Trowa Barton
%4■Real Name■%1
Unknown
%4■Profile■%1
> A quiet boy who shows little emotion, with calm, accurate judgment and bold decisiveness.
> By the time he was old enough to know anything, he was already fighting on the battlefield as a soldier, and everything about him -- birth, age, background, real name -- is unknown.
> Even the name Trowa was merely borrowed from Trowa Barton, who was supposed to pilot the Heavyarms in "Operation Meteor" but was killed just before it.
> Even so, through his life with Catherine, a girl of the circus troupe he slipped into to hide, and through acting together with his comrades, he has been gaining compassion and a generous heart.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Operation Meteor, Catherine. 'Hebiiaamuzu' -> 'Heavyarms' (glossary Gundam Heavyarms).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Quatre
%4■Full Name■%1
Quatre Raberba Winner
%4■Profile■%1
> A kindhearted boy, a natural genius who can do anything from art to piloting, yet never shows off about it.
> Heir to the immensely wealthy Winner family, he was raised in privileged surroundings with his 29 half-sisters.
> He can be soft, but he has firm ideas of his own, and the resolve and strong will to fight himself if need be.
> Mild and big-hearted, he is also a leader figure who can unite the five Gundam pilots, Heero and the rest, all strong personalities.
> He shows a natural gift for command as well: even while in a cockpit himself, he has the eye to survey the whole battlefield and can give precise orders.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Winner family.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Wufei
%4■Full Name■%1
Chang Wufei
%4■Profile■%1
> A solitary boy who goes his own way, obsessed with justice and strength.
> He instinctively sees through those with evil thoughts and attacks them without mercy.
> He believes justice without strength is meaningless, and demands that those who claim justice have the power to prove it.
> His attitude may seem high-handed at first glance, but that is precisely because his "justice" is extremely pure, and he believes "evil" must never be forgiven.
> He also calls his machines, the Shenlong Gundam and the Altron Gundam, "Nataku" with respect, and demands of himself that he always remain worthy of piloting them.
{x00}
rows.notes: Full name: kanji form plus katakana reading line collapsed to 'Chang Wufei'. Not in glossary: Nataku.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Relena
%4■Full Name■%1
Relena Darlian
%4■Real Name■%1
Relena Peacecraft
%4■Profile■%1
> The daughter of the Darlians; Mr. Darlian is Vice Foreign Minister of the United Earth Sphere Alliance.
> In truth, however, she is the last child of the royal family of the Sanc Kingdom, which advocated total pacifism and was destroyed by the United Earth Sphere Alliance, and the younger sister of Milliardo Peacecraft, alias Zechs Merquise, another survivor of that family.
> As befits one of noble birth, she never loses her dignified bearing, full of grace and pride, whatever the situation.
> She had been living a wealthy, stable, ordinary life, but after her adoptive father Darlian was assassinated by OZ and she learned of her origins, she rose up to realize total pacifism and acted with great energy.
> Her charisma and her firm, never-surrendering conviction moved many people, and in time these qualities would carry her onto center stage.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'Gaimu jikan, Dorian fusai no musume' is ambiguous about who is vice minister; attributed to Mr. Darlian since the entry later calls Darlian her adoptive father. Not in glossary: United Earth Sphere Alliance, Relena Peacecraft (surname from glossary Milliardo Peacecraft). | [editorial] "they" read as "many people"; referent is her charisma and conviction

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Sally
%4■Full Name■%1
Sally Po
%4■Profile■%1
> A woman who backs up Heero and the other Gundam pilots.
> Formerly a major in the United Earth Sphere Alliance's medical intelligence department, she came to question the methods of the Alliance and OZ after meeting Heero and the others, and threw herself into the anti-OZ forces.
> She has insight and information-gathering skills sharp enough to find things that have sunk to the bottom of the sea and to make contact with the elusive Gundam pilots.
> A wise woman whose strength and kindness are real, not superficial, she acts with a clear sense of what she can do and what she should do.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Rashid
%4■Full Name■%1
Rashid Kurama
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the Maganac Corps, an MS unit that resists OZ.
> First-rate in leadership, drive and combat ability alike, he is deeply trusted by his men.
> The Maganac Corps, himself included, are devoted to Quatre, and will not hesitate to act for Quatre's sake even if it means risking their lives.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Zechs
%4■Full Name■%1
Zechs Merquise
%4■Real Name■%1
Milliardo Peacecraft
%4■Profile■%1
> An MS pilot who fights with a mask hiding his face and his past, known as the "Lightning Count."
> A close friend of OZ leader Treize Khushrenada, he is a warrior who fights for Treize's ideals and for his own pride.
> His true identity is Milliardo Peacecraft, orphaned heir of the royal family of the Sanc Kingdom, which advocated total pacifism and was destroyed by the United Earth Sphere Alliance, and older brother of Relena.
> Defying the teachings of his late father and homeland, he stained his hands with blood to take revenge on the Alliance; he entrusts the Sanc Kingdom's ideals to his sister Relena, and chooses to live as a pawn in their service.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'Raitoningu Kaunto (kousoku no hakushaku)': the bracketed Japanese gloss means the same thing and is dropped. Not in glossary: Lightning Count.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Milliardo
%4■Full Name■%1
Milliardo Peacecraft
%4■Profile■%1
> A survivor of the royal family of the Sanc Kingdom, which advocated total pacifism and was destroyed by the United Earth Sphere Alliance.
> He is Relena's real older brother.
> Defying the teachings of his late father and homeland, he stained his hands with blood to take revenge on the Alliance; he entrusts the Sanc Kingdom's ideals to his sister Relena, and chooses to live as a pawn in their service.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Noin
%4■Full Name■%1
Lucrezia Noin
%4■Profile■%1
> A soldier who excels both as an MS pilot and as an instructor.
> A noble-minded woman who loves Zechs and lives for him.
> At the officer academy she always aimed for second place so that he would come first, and since graduating she has kept supporting him, both behind the scenes and in the open.
> She remembers exactly the last day she saw Zechs, and keeps an exact count of the days since.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] "count of the last day" was illogical phrasing

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Treize
%4■Full Name■%1
Treize Khushrenada
%4■Profile■%1
> An executive of the Romefeller Foundation and leader of the secret society OZ.
> OZ was originally an MS corps formed inside the United Earth Sphere Alliance with the Romefeller Foundation's money, but it staged a coup and drove the Alliance to collapse.
> After the Alliance's collapse, OZ acted as the Romefeller Foundation's executive force for ruling the Earth Sphere.
> A born elite, he has it all -- powerful charisma, outstanding political skill, genius-level combat skill and handsome looks -- a man far above ordinary people.
> He has many supporters, and their trust in him is absolute.
> He seeks elegance in all his actions, and prefers battles that honor chivalry.
> He hopes that out of battle will emerge people who seek to win peace by their own strength, and that he will be defeated by such people.
> He also deeply mourns those who died for him in battle, and remembers their number and every one of their names.
{x00}
rows.notes: OZ reading in parentheses dropped. Not in glossary: Romefeller Foundation.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Lady Une
%4■Profile■%1
> Treize Khushrenada's adjutant.
> She has excellent abilities as a commander, as a pilot, and even as an administrator.
> To live up to Treize's ideals, she switches between two opposing personalities: a cold soldier who will stop at nothing, and a saintly woman who loves peace.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Mariemaia
%4■Full Name■%1
Mariemaia Khushrenada
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl who claims to be Treize Khushrenada's daughter and, as his successor, leads those who support her, asserting her right to rule the world.
> Wise beyond her years, she speaks and acts in a domineering way.
> But when she learns the true intentions of those who hold her up as a symbol, what will this bright girl do?
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Domon
%4■Full Name■%1
Domon Kasshu
%4■Profile■%1
> Champion of colony martial arts, and Neo Japan's representative Gundam Fighter in the 13th Gundam Fight.
> A martial artist of the Undefeated of the East School, and the only disciple of Master Asia, the Undefeated of the East.
> After ten years of training from childhood, he inherited the title of King of Hearts from his master.
> He used to be a man who simply charged ahead without thinking, but through special training in the Guiana Highlands he has attained the state of Meikyo Shisui, a mind clear as still water.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Gundam Fight/Fighter, Neo Japan, Undefeated of the East school (ryuuha Touhou Fuhai), King of Hearts, Guiana Highlands, Meikyo Shisui (term kept, with a short rendering of its meaning).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rain
%4■Full Name■%1
Rain Mikamura
%4■Profile■%1
> A staff member of Neo Japan's Gundam team.
> A qualified doctor, she supports both Domon and the Gundam as mechanic and physician.
> Domon's childhood friend; her father is Dr. Mikamura, developer of the Shining Gundam.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns (gender not given in source or glossary). Not in glossary: Shining Gundam, Dr. Mikamura. | [editorial] glossary gives Rain as female: name-repetition workaround smoothed; pronoun smoothing (Rain f)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Chibodee
%4■Full Name■%1
Chibodee Crocket
%4■Profile■%1
> Neo America's representative Gundam Fighter, who bears the Queen the Spade crest.
> He spent his childhood in street fights and rose with nothing but his fists from the downtown streets of Earth to become colony boxing champion, and is hailed as a hero, the man who embodies the American Dream.
> Self-confident and optimistic, he is strong in adversity.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Neo America, Queen the Spade. | [accuracy] 'slums' added a detail not in 'chikyuu no daunntaun'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Sai Saici
%4■Profile■%1
> Neo China's Gundam Fighter, who bears the Club Ace crest.
> Heir to the Shaolin Temple on Earth.
> However, that Shaolin Temple has fallen into ruin, because many of its martial arts trainees have gone up to the Chikurin Temple in the colonies.
> He entered the Gundam Fight to fulfill his clan's long-cherished wish of restoring it.
> He lost his father when he was young and was raised by his guardians, Zuisan and Keiun.
> Proud of his cooking, he is a cheerful, friendly joker, but surprisingly crafty.
> His grandfather, Sai Feilong, won the 4th Gundam Fight.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Neo China, Club Ace, Shaolin Temple, Chikurin Temple (romanized; literally 'Bamboo Grove Temple' -- uncertain official form), Zuisan, Keiun, Sai Feilong.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
George
%4■Full Name■%1
George de Sand
%4■Profile■%1
> Neo France's representative Gundam Fighter, who bears the Jack in Diamond crest.
> A descendant of Neo France's distinguished Sand family, he entered the Gundam Fight staking his nation's honor and prestige.
> Full of chivalry, he is serious and proud, and hates underhanded behavior.
> A skilled swordsman, he is also called the Prince of Roses for his elegant manner.
{x00}
rows.notes: Glossary has no gender; 'he' from 'kikoushi' (young nobleman). Not in glossary: Neo France, Jack in Diamond, Prince of Roses.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Argo
%4■Full Name■%1
Argo Gulskii
%4■Profile■%1
> Neo Russia's representative Gundam Fighter, who bears the Black Joker crest.
> He was once a space pirate notorious for raiding colonies, but his men were captured by Neo Russia, and he is taking part in the Gundam Fight on the condition that they be released.
> A small bomb is attached to his chest to stop him from escaping.
> A taciturn man who rarely shows his emotions.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Neo Russia, Black Joker.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Undefeated of the East
%4■Full Name■%1
Master Asia, Undefeated of the East
%4■Profile■%1
> Undefeated of the East, commonly known as Master Asia.
> A master of the "Undefeated of the East School" and Domon Kasshu's teacher.
> Neo Hong Kong's representative Gundam Fighter, and winner of the 12th Gundam Fight.
> He is also the previous leader of the Shuffle Alliance, which has guarded the "order of battle" from the shadows of history for four thousand years -- the King of Hearts.
> He excels at techniques that make full use of cloth, powerful enough to destroy an MS with his bare body.
> With his graceful, invincible techniques he built the legend of the Undefeated.
{x00}
rows.notes: Reading in parentheses on the name line dropped. Not in glossary: Neo Hong Kong, Shuffle Alliance. 'Fuhai shinwa' rendered 'the legend of the Undefeated'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Stalker
%4■Profile■%1
> A mysterious figure known for the line "Everyone, the wait is over!"
> The guide who invites viewers into the world of G Gundam.
> Wears an eyepatch over the right eye, though there is nothing particularly wrong with that eye, and removes the eyepatch when dressed as a referee.
> Catchphrase: "Gundam Fight! Ready... GO!!"
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronouns (gender not given in source or glossary). 'Minasan, omachikane!' rendered 'Everyone, the wait is over!'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Uso
%4■Full Name■%1
Uso Ewin
%4■Profile■%1
> A 13-year-old from Kasarelia.
> Taught all kinds of things by his parents since early childhood, he has a vast knowledge far beyond his years, from handling computers and other machines to piloting MS (mobile suits), and even how to prepare himself mentally for any situation.
> He also has ample talent to make use of that knowledge.
> As a result, he becomes a central pilot of League Militaire.
> Even caught up in that fighting, he remains an honest, kind boy who even worries about the safety of enemy pilots, and he keeps fighting because he does not want the people around him to die.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Kasarelia, League Militaire.

rows.en:
%4■Known As■%1
Mafty
%4■Full Name■%1
Mafty Navue Erin
%4■Name■%1
Hathaway Noa
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the anti-Earth Federation organization Mafty Erin.
> His true identity is Hathaway Noa, son of Earth Federation Forces Colonel Bright Noa.
> Piloting the cutting-edge mobile suit Xi Gundam, he carries out purges of corrupt senior Earth Federation Forces officials.
> Though aware that terrorism is by no means a praiseworthy means, he keeps acting in the belief that people who see their actions will one day rise up.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label: tsuushou -> 'Alias'; source header order (Alias / Full Name / Name) kept. Xi reading in parentheses dropped. Organization 'Mafutii Erin' -> 'Mafty Erin' (glossary Mafty Navue Erin). Taisa -> 'Captain' per glossary position for Bright. | [accuracy] taisa = Colonel (project decision)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kenneth
%4■Full Name■%1
Kenneth Sleg
%4■Profile■%1
> An Earth Federation Forces officer.
> A capable man who handles everything from MS (mobile suit) development to pilot training and combat command, and even pilots himself.
> As a soldier he has a cold, strict side, but he is no stick-in-the-mud; he is full of feeling and a flexible thinker.
> Though he belongs to the Earth Federation Forces, he dislikes the arrogant, selfish nature of the Federation government's ministers.
> He stays in the military simply because he loves MS, and being in the military lets him stay involved with them.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'He' from 'sonna kare ga' in the source. | [editorial] consistency with "pilot" used throughout the entry; "no stiff" is slang (corpse); "emotional" read as negative for kanjou yutaka

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gigi
%4■Full Name■%1
Gigi Andalusia
%4■Profile■%1
> A mysterious girl.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Jiron
%4■Full Name■%1
Jiron Amos
%4■Profile■%1
> The son of a Rockman (one of the people who make their living mining minerals) known as "Iron Arm."
> Straightforward and bold, he is a fine young man bursting with energy -- the very picture of headlong recklessness.
> Breaking the "Three-Day Rule" of Zora, where he lives, under which all is forgiven once three days have passed, he pursues Timp, who killed his parents, for revenge.
> Feeling he needed a Walker Machine for his revenge, Jiron tried to steal the Iron Gear's Xabungle, and that led him to travel with Elchi, Rag and the others.
> Perhaps he is a bit self-conscious about his round face: he once flew into a rage when called "Melon Amos."
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Rockman, Zora, Three-Day Rule, Walker Machine, Iron Gear (glossary entry has no English). 'Iron Arm' attached to the Rockman (father), as in the Japanese word order. | [editorial] "reckless charging" unidiomatic

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Elchi
%4■Full Name■%1
Elchi Cargo
%4■Profile■%1
> The female captain of the Iron Gear, who took charge of the Cargo family of haulers after her father, Carrying Cargo, died in an accident.
> Though she longs for culture and hates barbarism, she is strong-willed and constantly causing trouble.
> She is also an expert knife thrower.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Carrying Cargo, Cargo family.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rag
%4■Full Name■%1
Rag Uralo
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the Sand Rats, a gang of reckless drivers made up entirely of orphans.
> A cheerful, lively, big-sisterly girl who looks after others.
> Getting involved with Jiron leads her to travel with the Iron Gear.
> Before she knew it, she had developed special feelings for Jiron, and she often clashes with Elchi.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: Sandrats. 'Bousouzoku' rendered 'gang of road rats' (a reckless-driving gang). | [editorial] "road rats" next to the name Sand Rats read oddly (accuracy flag); bousouzoku; tense smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Blume
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy who was in the Sand Rats led by Rag.
> He sometimes speaks and acts coolly, but he is a boy with a passionate heart.
> He likes Rag and often clashes with Jiron, but he is skilled and dependable.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Horla
%4■Full Name■%1
Kid Horla
%4■Profile■%1
> A Breaker (bodyguard) acting on his own under orders from a mysterious figure.
> He is in love with Elchi, and makes touching efforts to win her heart.
> He was originally something of a leader among the Breakers hired by the Cargo family.
> When Elchi's father, Carrying Cargo, died and the Iron Gear changed captains, he rushed to marry Elchi and take over, but he was beaten by Jiron and had to leave the ship.
> That is why he treats Jiron as his sworn enemy.
{x00}
rows.notes: 'He' from glossary gender for Horla (male).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Geraba
%4■Full Name■%1
Geraba Geraba
%4■Profile■%1
> Horla's toady.
> He too was originally a member of the Cargo family, but when Horla broke away, Geraba left with him.
> He can never resist saying one word too many, so Horla often punches him.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] name repetition (Horla is male); 'says one word too many' smoothed (accuracy flag)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Timp
%4■Full Name■%1
Timp Sharon
%4■Profile■%1
> A lone-wolf Breaker.
> A formidable man known as "the War Instigator."
> As the man who killed Jiron Amos's parents, he ends up being relentlessly pursued by Jiron.
> One might expect him to prefer being alone, but once he settles in as captain of a Land Ship, he actually takes delight in being called "Captain."
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered as the epithet "the War Instigator"; [jp] = Land Ship (not in glossary). | [editorial] stiff 'is suited to being alone'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Sho
%4■Full Name■%1
Sho Zama
%4■Profile■%1
> A Japanese boy with high Aura Power, summoned to Byston Well as a Holy Warrior by Drake Luft, then a provincial lord in the Kingdom of A.
> He was initially with Drake's army, but through experiences such as meeting Marvel Frozen he came to question Drake's actions, and became a Holy Warrior on the anti-Drake side.
> His Aura Power stands out even among the Holy Warriors summoned to Byston Well, and he becomes the symbol of the anti-Drake cause.
{x00}
rows.notes: Place/term spellings (Byston Well, Kingdom of A, Holy Warrior, Aura Power) taken from the Sunrise Eiyuutan sibling glossary; not in this project's glossary. [jp] (sic in source) read as [jp] 'summoned'. | [editorial] misplaced modifier: 'with high Aura Power by Drake Luft'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Chum
%4■Full Name■%1
Chum Huau
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl of the Mi Ferario, a fairy-like race.
> She is energetic, full of curiosity, and quite good with her hands.
> At times she can see the light of a person's aura, which is said to differ from person to person.
{x00}
rows.notes: Mi Ferario from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Marvel
%4■Full Name■%1
Marvel Frozen
%4■Profile■%1
> A woman from Dallas, America, who had been summoned to Byston Well before Sho Zama.
> Quick to see through Drake Luft's malice, she had been fighting against Drake together with Nie Given and others.
> She seems to be interested in Eastern philosophy, for instance practicing Zen meditation to calm her mind.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Nie
%4■Full Name■%1
Nie Given
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the Zelerna unit, which keeps up its resistance to Drake from its base, the Aura Ship Zelerna.
> The eldest son of Romun Given, head of House Given, provincial lords in the Kingdom of A.
> Together with his father he sought to crush Drake's ambitions, but instead his parents were killed and his lands were seized.
> Even so, he continued the fight at the head of the Zelerna and its unit, persuading the Kingdoms of Lau, Na and others and uniting them into an anti-Drake force.
> At first his self-centered behavior, typical of a spoiled young noble, stood out, and he often clashed with those around him, but he gradually came to act with the awareness of a commander.
{x00}
rows.notes: Romun Given, House Given from the sibling glossary. [jp] rendered 'Zelerna unit'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ciela
%4■Full Name■%1
Ciela Lapana
%4■Profile■%1
> Queen of the Kingdom of Na.
> The Kingdom of Na that she rules is one of the foremost great powers of Byston Well, and is even said to be stronger than the Kingdom of A.
> Though she is a girl whose looks still retain a trace of childishness, she has a composure, grace and insight that belie her age, and understands both the merits and the evils of Aura Machines.
> Always aware that she is a sovereign responsible for a great many subjects, she holds herself to strict discipline.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Elle
%4■Full Name■%1
Elle Hunm
%4■Profile■%1
> The only daughter of Pinegan Hunm, King of Mi, and granddaughter of Foizon Gow, King of the great Kingdom of Lau.
> She possesses strong Aura Power and can also foresee the future.
> After the Kingdom of Mi was attacked and destroyed by Drake, she lived in hiding deep in remote mountains, but when her grandfather King Foizon fell in battle, she took up his cause and, as Queen of Lau, joined the fight against Drake and his allies.
> Unlike Ciela, however, she never received a full education as a ruler, so at times she is nearly crushed by the weight of her duties and loses heart.
{x00}
rows.notes: Pinegan Hunm from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Foizon
%4■Full Name■%1
Foizon Gow
%4■Profile■%1
> King of the Kingdom of Lau, a great power ranking alongside A, Na and Ku.
> A bold warrior who, though king, personally boards an AB (Aura Battler) to fight on the front lines.
> Stubborn and stern, but a trustworthy man, deeply loyal to what is right, with a strong sense of justice.
> Righteously indignant at Drake's atrocities, he eagerly developed Aura Machines as a force to crush Drake's ambitions, and had also put mass production of ABs in place.
> As king, he considers it his duty to stand at the forefront himself and set an example for his people.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Todd
%4■Full Name■%1
Todd Guinness
%4■Profile■%1
> A young man from Boston, America, summoned to Byston Well as a Holy Warrior by Drake Luft around the same time as Sho.
> He took a liking to Byston Well, and has the ambition to make a name for himself and rise in the world.
> Drawing on his experience and skills as a former US Air Force pilot, he fights piloting an AB (Aura Battler), but is defeated by Sho, who has turned enemy.
> Ever since, he has burned with rivalry toward Sho, but no matter how many times he tries he cannot win, and in time fighting Sho becomes the very purpose of his battles.
> He is also a surprisingly dutiful son, and the wish to give his mother a good life seems to be one of his reasons for fighting.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'devoted to his family' (filial). | [accuracy] [jp] = devoted to his parents (filial), not to his family in general; the sentence is about his mother

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Bern
%4■Full Name■%1
Bern Bunnings
%4■Profile■%1
> Knight Commander of Drake's army.
> A self-assured man who values status and honor, he takes great pride in coming from a family of knights.
> A man beyond reproach in both rank and ability, he enjoyed the deep trust of his lord Drake, and there was even talk of marriage to Drake's daughter Riml; he in turn aimed to use it as a stepping stone to become Drake's successor himself.
> Once Sho turned against them, however, he suffered failure after failure and defeat after defeat, and finally lost Drake's trust.
> As a result his path to advancement was cut off, and he left Drake's army as if driven out.
> Because of this, he comes to harbor an abnormally intense hatred of Sho.
{x00}
rows.notes: Riml (Luft) from the sibling glossary. | [accuracy] [jp] is not hedged: 'almost' softened it

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Black Knight
%4■Real Name■%1
Bern Bunnings
%4■Profile■%1
> The form in which Bern Bunnings -- repeatedly defeated by Sho Zama, his honor as a knight crushed and abandoned even by his lord Drake -- rose again behind a mask, bent on redeeming his disgrace.
> His Aura Power of hatred, fueled by that humiliation, is in no way inferior to Sho's.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label [jp] = 'Real Name'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Garalia
%4■Full Name■%1
Garalia Nyamhee
%4■Profile■%1
> A female warrior of Drake's army.
> Though she comes from a warrior family, her father fled in the face of the enemy, so she spent a humiliating childhood as a coward's child.
> She volunteered to become a warrior and seeks to clear her name through military merit, so she often rushes ahead.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Musiy
%4■Full Name■%1
Musiy Poe
%4■Profile■%1
> A female warrior of Drake's army.
> Originally the music teacher of Riml, daughter of Drake Luft, she became a warrior after Shot Weapon, developer of the AB (Aura Battler), discovered her talent.
> She possesses strong Aura Power and, despite her limited combat experience, performs excellently on the battlefield.
{x00}
rows.notes: Shot Weapon from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Drake
%4■Full Name■%1
Drake Luft
%4■Profile■%1
> King of the Kingdom of A, at the head of Drake's army.
> He was originally no more than the lord of Laas Wau, one province of the Kingdom of A, but after meeting Shot Weapon and obtaining Aura Machines, he came to harbor the ambition of seizing the Kingdom of A, and ultimately all of Byston Well.
> A master of intrigue, he quickly brought the Kingdom of A under his control and secured his footing in Byston Well.
> With the kingdom's might, its advanced technology and the overwhelming force of its powerful Aura Machines, he moves his army to fulfill his ambitions.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized 'Laas Wau' (not in any glossary; unverified).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Daba
%4■Full Name■%1
Daba Myroad
%4■Real Name■%1
Kamon Myroad
%4■Profile■%1
> A young man who leads the rebels against Poseidal.
> Originally, with his best friend Mirawoo Kyao and the handmade HM (Heavy Metal) L-Gaim, he left Ugol Village, out in the backwoods of the frontier planet Koam, aiming to rise in the world in the Poseidal Army.
> But having seen with his own eyes the contradictions and absurdity of Poseidal's tyranny, he threw in his lot with the rebels, who keep resisting despite an overwhelming gap in strength.
> Through his exploits and his lineage, he gradually becomes the symbol of the rebellion.
> In truth, he is a survivor of the Kamon royal family of the Yaman people, whom Poseidal once wiped out.
> He had learned this from his foster father, Daba Hassar, but when he first left the village he had no ambition to restore the royal house; his aim, it seems, was to search for his missing foster sister, Quwasan Olibee.
> He gives the impression of an earnest, thoughtful and gentle young man, but when necessary he shows truly bold initiative.
> He can also be indecisive and easily swept along, but deep down he holds firm values, and will never yield on anything that goes against them.
> His is a kindness with a firm backbone, one that cannot tolerate injustice.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] ('Kamon'), [jp] ('Ugol') romanized, not in any glossary. Koam, Daba Hassar, Yaman from the sibling glossary. [jp] rendered 'foster sister'. | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Lilis
%4■Full Name■%1
Lilis Faw
%4■Profile■%1
> A survivor of the Mirarii, a winged people who apparently once flourished in the Pentagona World.
> Held captive in a sideshow in Prearmo, a town on Koam, she was rescued by Daba and began to follow him around.
> At first she was silent, but perhaps because she grew used to things, she gradually became cheerful and talkative.
{x00}
rows.notes: Mirarii, Prearmo, Pentagona World from the sibling glossary (this glossary's position text says 'Mirary' / 'Pryamo').

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kyao
%4■Full Name■%1
Mirawoo Kyao
%4■Profile■%1
> Daba's best friend, a young man who left the Koam countryside with him to join the regular army.
> In reality Daba had other plans, but Kyao seriously dreamed of rising in the regular army, and when they first ended up on the side opposing it, he showed considerable regret.
> By temperament he is short-tempered, a show-off and a soft touch.
> A big eater with tremendous strength, he is a clown who fancies himself a heartthrob.
> He can pilot too, but he is extremely good with machines and is even more capable as a mechanic.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'a clown who fancies himself a heartthrob'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Amm
%4■Full Name■%1
Fannaria Amm
%4■Profile■%1
> A slender girl proud of her long, beautiful black hair and her long legs.
> She had hoped to become a stage actress, but caught the eye of Miyama Lilin, the female boss of a band of thieves, and had become a thief.
> However, she fell for Daba, the target of one of their raids, left the band and began to travel with him.
> A girl brimming with vitality, for Daba's sake she will even pilot an HM (Heavy Metal).
> She is strong-willed and sometimes goes too far, but that too is because her feelings for Daba are so pure.
{x00}
rows.notes: Miyama Lilin from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Leccee
%4■Full Name■%1
Gaw Ha Leccee
%4■Profile■%1
> A former member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> She, however, was drawn to Daba, abandoned her position and chose to work on the rebel side.
> Highly capable as a warrior, she shows her skill in many areas, from piloting to tactics.
> For that very reason, she worries about the rebels, who lack both resolve and ability, and sometimes ends up taking action alone.
> On the other hand, she is always quarreling with Amm over Daba, showing she still has a girlish side.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'the Thirteen'; the repeated definition paragraph is worded identically in rows 100, 105-109. | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Semuge
%4■Full Name■%1
Semuge Shato
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the rebels resisting Poseidal on Trydetol.
> At first he planned to set up Daba and his companions, who had been pulling off flashy exploits, as figureheads of the rebellion while he pulled the strings from behind.
> He was in fact a spy whom Full Flat had planted among the rebels, and he was also connected with Amandra, even receiving supplies from him.
> Gradually, however, he came to recognize Daba's drive and noble character, and to follow him wholeheartedly.
{x00}
rows.notes: Trydetol from the sibling glossary. | [editorial] unidiomatic 'making exploits'; doubled 'came to'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Full Flat
%4■Profile■%1
> Queen of the artificial celestial body Theart Star, which Oldna Poseidal has granted independent self-rule.
> A mysterious woman who never ages, she watches the strife across Pentagona from the sidelines while living peacefully in her own kingdom, surrounded only by women.
> She seems to have more than a passing connection with Amandra and Poseidal...
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] spelled 'Theart Star' per sibling glossary; this glossary's position text for Full Flat says 'Sart Star' -- needs a decision.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Quwasan
%4■Full Name■%1
Quwasan Olibee
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of a decoy unit within the Poseidal Army that specializes in hunting down the remnants of the Yaman people.
> She later becomes operations commander of the Imperial Guard Division.
> She is in fact Daba's foster sister, kidnapped long ago, but she has been brainwashed and turned into Poseidal's puppet by a Bio Sensor.
{x00}
rows.notes: Pronouns from glossary gender (female); [jp] = 'Imperial Guard Division'. | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gablae
%4■Full Name■%1
Gavlet Gablae
%4■Profile■%1
> A young man from a family of provincial nobles fallen on hard times, who volunteered for the Poseidal Regular Army aiming to restore his house.
> He tries to play it cool, but perhaps because he is hot-blooded at heart, he is somewhat scatterbrained and endearing.
> He himself is always perfectly serious, but to onlookers that very earnestness looks comical.
> He regards Daba as a rival, and at every turn he burns with competitive spirit and picks fights with him.
> He falls in love easily, and is especially infatuated with Quwasan, devotedly doing his very best out of his feelings for her.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Nei
%4■Full Name■%1
Nei Moh Han
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> Deputy of the Koam Division Intelligence Bureau, she directs field operations under the bureau chief, Giwaza Lowaw.
> She is also Giwaza's lover, and would not hesitate to risk her life for his sake.
{x00}
rows.notes: Pronouns from glossary gender (female). | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

Chai
%4■Full Name■%1
Chai Char
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> Commander of Prearmo Base, on the outskirts of Prearmo, a provincial city on Koam.

> An ambitious, gloomy individual.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gania
%4■Full Name■%1
Barn Gania Killas
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> Commander of the Mizun Division Space Forces.

{x00}

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
McTomin
%4■Full Name■%1
Maph McTomin
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> Commander-in-chief of the Gastogal Division.
> True to his bizarre appearance, he turns berserker-like in battle, fighting while letting out shrill cries.
> When Giwaza revolted against Poseidal, he sided with Giwaza and led the vanguard.
{x00}

[jp] rendered 'shrill cries'. | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form) | [editorial] stiff 'becomes like a berserker'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Giwaza
%4■Full Name■%1
Giwaza Lowaw
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Thirteen of the Poseidal Regular Army.
> Chief of the Koam Division Intelligence Bureau.
> Though third in rank among the Thirteen, he was their de facto leader.
> The Thirteen are formally known as the Poseidal Regular Army Secret Intelligence Agency, a group made up entirely of hand-picked elites even within the Poseidal Army. Their main purpose is to expose anti-Poseidal movements, and they hold great sway within the military.
> But the corruption within the Poseidal Army, his distrust of Poseidal's rule and his own ambition led him to revolt, aspiring to become the master of Pentagona himself.
> His strong command ability and political skill led many of the Thirteen to follow his revolt, but he seems to lack the caliber to sit at the top himself.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Poseidal Army; [jp] capitalised as Poseidal Regular Army (term_fixes unifies on that form)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Poseidal
%4■Full Name■%1
Oldna Poseidal
%4■Real Name■%1
Mian Ku Ha Attsher
%4■Profile■%1
> The dictator who unified the Pentagona World by force of arms and rules it.
> Using the Bio Relation System, she absorbs the bio-energy of the residents of the capital, Sveto, to maintain eternal youth.
> In truth she is Mian Ku Ha Attsher, a member of the Temple Knights (the royal guard knights of the Poseidal royal house of planet Gastogal), who once fought alongside the true Poseidal, Amandra, to unify Pentagona, and who was also his lover.
> At Poseidal's request she serves as his body double under his control, but perhaps because she has played Poseidal for so long, she herself has come to believe she is Poseidal.
{x00}
rows.notes: The JP real name is split over two lines; English fits on one. Mian Ku Ha Attsher, Temple Knights, Sveto, Bio Relation from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Amandra
%4■Full Name■%1
Amandra Kamandra
%4■Real Name■%1
Oldna Poseidal
%4■Profile■%1
> Founder of the Amandra Konzern, the largest conglomerate in the Pentagona World.
> Operating as the Aman Trading Company, he supplies weapons to both the regular army and the rebels, and is therefore called a war profiteer, a "merchant of death."
> His true identity is Oldna Poseidal, who unified Pentagona -- the true Poseidal.
> After pacifying Pentagona, he gained eternal youth through the Bio Relation System and had his lover Mian Ku Ha Attsher act as his body double, while he himself enjoys reigning as the shadow ruler who manipulates her from behind the scenes.
{x00}
rows.notes: Aman Trading Company from the sibling glossary; [jp] kept as 'Konzern'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
True Poseidal
%4■Full Name■%1
Oldna Poseidal
%4■Profile■%1
> The man who unified the Pentagona World by force of arms.
> Maintaining his youth by absorbing the bio-energy of the residents of the capital, Sveto, with the Bio Relation System, he had his former lover Mian Ku Ha Attsher act as his body double, while he himself goes by the name Amandra and moves about freely as a mere merchant.
> On top of that, as the shadow ruler who manipulates her -- Poseidal -- he amuses himself by rolling Pentagona around in the palm of his hand.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Kaine
%4■Full Name■%1
Kaine Wakaba
%4■Profile■%1
> Self-proclaimed leader of the Dragonar Team.
> He has a Japanese mother and an American father.
> He is quick to pick a fight, the type to throw a punch before saying a word, and can give the impression of a flirtatious, unserious delinquent, but in truth he is a kind-hearted, manly boy who hates anything cowardly or crooked.
> Being clumsy with people, however, he often clashes with his comrades.
> He acts tough and is headstrong, but he also has an innocent side: he is weak around girls.
> He is utterly helpless around his beloved Linda Plato in particular.
> When he first boarded the Dragonar, he was defeated by Meio Plato, "the Blue Falcon of Giganos," and keenly felt his own inexperience, the terror of battle, and the heavy responsibility of one entrusted with a Dragonar.
> His piloting is still rough, but through natural talent and the experience of surviving many fierce battles, he eventually gains power surpassing even "the Blue Falcon of Giganos," and becomes an ace pilot of the Earth Alliance forces.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'Earth Alliance forces' to keep it distinct from Gundam's [jp] (Earth Federation Forces); not in glossary. [jp] = 'the Blue Falcon of Giganos'. | [accuracy] late decision: 'Dragonar Team' (capital T) when it names the unit | [editorial] awkward 'fists move before his mouth'; a 'side' cannot be weak around girls

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Tapp
%4■Full Name■%1
Tapp Oceano
%4■Profile■%1
> A gentle, strong boy, always cheerful and bright, who cares deeply about his family.
> The eldest of six siblings.
> Perhaps because he grew up among many siblings, he is good at looking after others.
> He also serves as a buffer between the emotional Kaine and the logical Light, and keeps the whole crew's spirits up.
> He always carries so many things around that Kaine once asked in exasperation, "You planning to open a department store?" and at times he proves dependable when it counts.
