> Despite his looks he is attentive to fine details, and with money in particular he is far more careful than Kaine or Light -- so much so that he used his own cash card PIN as the D-2's registration number.
> As for why he joined the military, partly it was just how things turned out, but the fact that the military pays a salary seems to have been a big factor.
> That does not mean he is greedy about money, though; it is all so he can send money to his family living back home.
> In combat he mainly handles bombardment, but he also has the nerve to make all-out ramming attacks that rely on sheer power.
> He has feelings for Rose Pattenton, who was with them as a refugee from the Giganos invasion, and their relationship seems to be going rather well.
{x00}
rows.notes: D[jp] written 'D-2' (glossary: Dragonar-2). Rose Pattenton from the sibling glossary; no pronoun used for Rose. | [editorial] 'mood-maker' is Japanese-English | [proofread] punctuation: no comma after a quoted question mark

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Light
%4■Full Name■%1
Light Newman
%4■Profile■%1
> From a distinguished family with British aristocratic blood, he can be a little affected, but he is a likable young man who never acts stuck-up.
> He is smart, but perhaps because he dislikes being boxed in, he hangs out with Kaine and Tapp, who live freely despite being dropouts.
> His hobby is fine food, and he sometimes lets slip that army food tastes awful.
> He is handsome yet somehow scatterbrained, and has little luck with women.
> He seems to like Diane, but she will not give him the time of day -- poor guy.
> Then again, that may be what makes him so hard to dislike.
> In battle too he is always calm and composed, but he also has a passionate side that will not let him leave a comrade in a pinch.
> The D-3 he pilots is mainly a rear-support unit for radar surveillance, information disruption, reconnaissance and the like, but when it counts it can also handle close combat.
> He understands the feelings of both nobles and commoners, which in a way makes him uniquely valuable.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered plain 'Diane'. | [editorial] illogical subject ('a side that cannot leave a comrade'); 'a rare presence' is a calque of [jp]

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Linda
%4■Full Name■%1
Linda Plato
%4■Profile■%1
> Meio's younger sister.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] = younger sister.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Diane
%4■Full Name■%1
Diane Lance
%4■Profile■%1
> She had blended in with the refugees as an ordinary civilian, but is in fact a secret intelligence agent of the Earth Alliance forces.
> Her rank is ensign.
> She is a good shot and always makes calm judgments.
> She is beautiful as well as gentle and graceful, and takes good care of others.
> Truly the ideal big sister -- her one flaw is that she is a bad drunk.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] = second lieutenant (glossary position text agrees). | [accuracy] late decision rank ladder: [jp] = Ensign | [editorial] unidiomatic 'judge calmly'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Meio
%4■Full Name■%1
Meio Plato
%4■Alias■%1
Blue Falcon of Giganos
%4■Profile■%1
> A young ace of the Giganos Army with astonishing MA (Metal Armor) piloting skills.
> His demonic strength has earned him the name "the Blue Falcon of Giganos," and he is feared by both the Giganos Imperial Army and the Earth Alliance forces.
> However, the Giganos leadership fears a revolt because of his overwhelming combat ability, and considers it dangerous to give him a large force.
> For this reason he is only ever given a small force, and he has no choice but to operate almost alone.
> Yet even in such thankless circumstances, Meio's own loyalty to the empire and its supreme leader, Marshal Giltor, is extremely high, and he has never even considered defecting.
> Always cool, calm and composed, he is also capable of bold decisions and action.
> He believes it is his mission to defeat both the Dragonars and his father, an authority on MA development who defected to the Alliance forces.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label [jp] = 'Alias'. The source writes [jp] in the header and [jp] in the text; both rendered 'Blue Falcon'. [jp] romanized 'Gilthor' (not in any glossary). | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army'); stiff 'operations are forced to be solo affairs' / 'has boldly decisive judgment'; 'both' keeps the two targets clear

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Karl
%4■Full Name■%1
Karl Geiner
%4■Profile■%1
> One of the Practies, cadets for the Giganos Army's Imperial Guard Mechanized Corps.
> The de facto leader of the Gelf unit.
> A man of natural genius, he shows a wild fighting style in an MA (Metal Armor).
> In appearance he has an air close to Meio Plato's, but he is haughty and proud, with an abnormally strong sense of elitism.
> He idolizes Meio, the ace pilot of Giganos, and volunteered to serve under him.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'Imperial Guard Mechanized Corps'. | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army')

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Welner
%4■Full Name■%1
Welner Fritz
%4■Profile■%1
> One of the Practies, cadets for the Giganos Army's Imperial Guard Mechanized Corps.
> A cerebral type with an abnormally strong sense of elitism, Welner believes the Practies are special.
> Highly skilled in combat, Welner is still very immature in temperament and eager to win glory.
> Welner idolizes Meio, the ace pilot of Giganos, and volunteered to serve under him.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written with the name instead of pronouns. [jp] = 'the Practies are special' (the cadets as a group). | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army'); name repetition reduced (no glossary gender, still pronoun-free)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Min
%4■Profile■%1
> Formerly the only woman in the Gun Jem team.
> She is physically tough, tomboyish and fiercely competitive.
> She has a cruel, ruthless side, but surprisingly she also looks after others, with a kind side that values her comrades.
> She has fallen for Meio Plato, and also has a womanly side, throwing herself into being of use to him.
{x00}
rows.notes: Gun Jem per this glossary (sibling glossary has 'Gon Jem'). | [accuracy] [jp] qualifies her membership (she used to be the team's only woman), not the team itself | [editorial] a 'side' cannot throw itself into anything

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Crinn
%4■Full Name■%1
Crinn Cashim
%4■Profile■%1
> Pilot of the Dougram, the CA (Combat Armor) that symbolizes the Fang of the Sun and, by extension, the Deloyer Liberation Army.
> The youngest child of Donan Cashim, Chairman of the Federal Council, who pulls the strings of the Deloyer State Government behind the scenes, he was raised rather indulgently.
> He respected his father, but came to have doubts about him as a politician -- a man who flatly declares that sacrificing the people of Deloyer, a minority, for the sake of the majority cannot be helped.
> He was also deeply shocked to see Federation soldiers killing Deloyer people like insects, calling it guerrilla hunting.
> Then, after meeting Dr. Samarin, an independence activist who preaches the true liberation of the Deloyer people, he joined the guerrillas of the Deloyer Liberation Army.
> At first, however, as he was not a Deloyer native, he could not win his comrades' trust.
> So he single-handedly recaptured the Dougram, which had been seized by the Deloyer State Government Army, proving himself, and from then on fought in the Liberation Army as the Dougram's pilot.
> Usually gentle and quiet, he has a strong core, bold drive and decisiveness.
> Not only is he highly skilled at piloting, he is a truly excellent pilot who can flexibly change tactics to suit the battle situation.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized 'Donan Cashim' (surname per glossary Crinn Cashim). [jp] = 'Federal Council'. | [accuracy] referent: 'when he flatly declared' could read as Crinn speaking; the source describes the father's stance as a politician ([jp]), not a single occasion | [editorial] unparallel 'Not only is his skill high, he is...' | [proofread] organisation casing: "Deloyer State Government (Army)" as in the machine library (proper name of the government and its army)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Chico
%4■Full Name■%1
Chico Biente
%4■Profile■%1
> A member of the Fang of the Sun.
> Despite his rough looks, he is a gentle, cheerful boy who is still only 19.
> Making use of his impressive build, he wields the powerful Big E Gun and takes on even CAs (Combat Armors) on foot.
> His family runs a repair shop, so he is good with machines, and repairing vehicles is second nature to him.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] glossary spelling ([jp] = Big E Gun; machine library uses the same)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
J. Locke
%4■Profile■%1
> Whether J. Locke is his real name is unknown, but that is what people call him.
> Leader of the "Star of Deloyer," one of the strongest groups in the Deloyer Liberation Army.
> He has saved the Dougram from danger time and again, teaching the "Fang of the Sun," whose members are all young, how to fight, and procuring the Turbo Zack and a trailer.
> A capable man of action who always thinks ahead and can give precise operational orders.
> He mainly fights at the head of a combat buggy unit.
> He is a rival of Zaltsev, a major in the Deloyer State Government Army, and the two apparently share a fateful past.
{x00}
rows.notes: Turbo Zack per this glossary ('Dougram/Turbo Zack'). | [proofread] organisation casing: "Deloyer State Government (Army)" as in the machine library (proper name of the government and its army)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Dr. Samarin
%4■Full Name■%1
David Samarin
%4■Profile■%1
> The central figure of the independence movement, who supports its theory as the spiritual pillar of the Deloyer Liberation Army.
> Originally a historian, he came to question Earth's policy toward Deloyer, and began preaching true freedom and independence for the Deloyer people.
> He denounces Von Stein's Deloyer State Government as no more than a puppet with no real power, and insists on a government standing on an equal footing.
> Aiming to establish a government in which minority opinions are reflected alongside those of the majority, he fights the Deloyer State Government Army.
> He greatly changed Crinn's life, teaching him what true freedom is and appointing him, though not a Deloyer native, as the Dougram's pilot.
{x00}
rows.notes: [proofread] organisation casing: "Deloyer State Government (Army)" as in the machine library (proper name of the government and its army)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Zaltsev
%4■Full Name■%1
Jackie Zaltsev
%4■Profile■%1
> A picture-perfect upright soldier, strict in both personal conduct and military discipline.
> Zaltsev holds the rank of major.
> Von Stein's most trusted subordinate, Zaltsev carries out various operations to defeat the Fang of the Sun, driving the Dougram into a corner time and again.
> Extremely capable as both strategist and warrior, Zaltsev keeps to a soldier's role and never comments on matters beyond the battlefield, and so is often at the mercy of political schemes.
> Zaltsev has a fateful past with J. Locke, and took an eye in a past confrontation with him.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written with the name instead of pronouns. [jp]: Zaltsev is the topic, so read as Zaltsev taking an eye; whose eye is not stated and is kept vague. | [accuracy] subject restored (no glossary gender, so the name is used) | [editorial] stiff 'strict with self' / 'superior officer Von Stein'; 'jerked around' too casual for the register; name repetition (J. Locke is male)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Garcia
%4■Full Name■%1
Vuldoran Garcia
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of the Garcia unit, a mercenary unit known for hunting guerrillas.
> Cunning and greedy.
> Garcia will kill without a second thought for money and glory.
> Garcia loves to torment victims slowly to death, and this brutal, inhuman conduct is notorious on Deloyer.
> After being defeated by the Fang of the Sun, Garcia came to hate the Dougram and pursues it relentlessly.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. | [accuracy] subject restored (no glossary gender, so the name is used)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Von Stein
%4■Profile■%1
> Representative of the Deloyer State Government and commander of the Federation 8th Army, which serves as that government's army.
> Originally a staff officer of the Federation Army's Deloyer Military District, he shot and killed the commander, Lieutenant General Danrock, seized the Federal Council and launched a coup for independence.
> But this had been arranged in advance with Donan Cashim, Chairman of the Federal Council, and its purpose was to flush out and wipe out Deloyer's pro-independence councilors and independence guerrillas.
> Though a Deloyer native himself, he wished not for Deloyer's independence but for it to coexist as a state within the Federation, and he founded the State of Deloyer and became its representative.
> As the right-hand man of Donan Cashim, Chairman of the Federal Council, he also stepped into the world of politics, but partly because he was unused to it, he merely did Donan's bidding.
> Even so, he agreed with Donan's ideas, and trusted in their rightness even when those around him called him "Donan's lapdog."
> But he did not get along with Lecoque, Donan's secretary who later became Acting Commissioner, and strongly resented being used as Lecoque's convenient pawn.
> A capable soldier, but too straightforward as a politician -- an ill-fated man.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized 'Danrock' (not in any glossary). [jp] rendered 'shot'. [jp] read as Lecoque's pawn. | [accuracy] [jp] = shot dead; 'shot' alone leaves the death unstated | [editorial] clumsy 'did no more than do'; doubled 'man' | [proofread] organisation casing: "Deloyer State Government (Army)" as in the machine library (proper name of the government and its army)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Lecoque
%4■Full Name■%1
Helmut J. Lecoque
%4■Profile■%1
> Acting Commissioner of the State of Deloyer.
> Formerly Donan Cashim's aide, he resented that no matter how devotedly he served, Donan never acknowledged him, and when Donan fell ill he seized the chance to act on his own.
> A sly man who never dirties his own hands, using others to get things done.
> He torments the Fang of the Sun away from the battlefield, pulling the strings of the military and politics from behind the scenes and using spies to draw Liberation Army leaders into schemes.
> Though capable, he lacks the charisma to draw people to him and is not fit to stand at the top himself, yet he harbors the ambition to become Chairman of the Federal Council once Donan is gone.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source calls him Donan's [jp] (secretary) in row 128 and [jp] (aide) here; kept as written. | [editorial] unclear 'bring schemes to'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Chirico
%4■Full Name■%1
Chirico Cuvie
%4■Profile■%1
> A former AT pilot of the Red Shoulder unit.
> "Red Shoulder" is the common name of the Melkian Army Armored Corps Special Mission Unit X-1, feared as the "Bloodsucking Unit" and "the bloodthirsty beasts of Gilgamesh" for its indiscriminate, merciless operations.
> His abnormally high survival rate, far beyond that of ordinary people, made him a research subject for Pailsen, but in time he was seen instead as a dangerous presence, and attempts were made on his life.
> Having grown up knowing nothing but war for as long as he can remember, he became taciturn and poor at dealing with people.
> His meeting with Fyana, a PS (Perfect Soldier) -- a human created to be the perfect soldier -- would greatly change his fate.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Fyana
%4■Code Name■%1
Proto One
%4■Known As■%1
Phantom Lady
%4■Profile■%1
> A woman developed as the first subject of Gilgamesh's PS (Perfect Soldier) project.
> The PS project aims to create the ideal soldier, a "Perfect Soldier" with physical abilities far beyond those of ordinary people, who obeys orders absolutely and carries out missions without hesitation.
> Furthermore, the knowledge needed for combat is input directly into the brain beforehand, while anything unnecessary is eliminated.
> However, because she met Chirico just before her birth, she came to harbor special feelings for him, and awakened incomplete as a human weapon.
> Even so, she has abilities that far surpass the reaction speed of ordinary humans.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header labels [jp] = 'Code Name', [jp] = 'Known As'. Proto One per glossary position text; [jp] = 'Phantom Lady'. | [editorial] stiff 'in a state incomplete as'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kan Yu
%4■Profile■%1
> Deputy commander of Assemble EX-10, a Kummen mercenary unit, and captain of its AT unit.
> Chirico's direct superior in Kummen.
> A reasonably skilled AT pilot, but perhaps because of a narrow-minded, easily emotional temperament, Kan Yu stands out as a commander mainly for short-sighted, incompetent leadership.
> On top of that, Kan Yu is a petty, cowardly small fry who wants to hog all the credit.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. Assemble EX-10 per glossary position text; Kummen from the sibling glossary. | [accuracy] subject and verb restored in a fragment (no glossary gender, so the name is used)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gon Nu
%4■Profile■%1
> The general who commands Assemble EX-10, a Kummen mercenary unit.
> Under a secret pact with Rochina, Gon Nu plans to recover the PS (Perfect Soldier) and defect to the Gilgamesh Army.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army')

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Epsilon
%4■Profile■%1
> The second PS (Perfect Soldier), following Proto One (Fyana).
> Perhaps because he was brought into being by Proto One, he has special feelings for her, and harbors a strong rivalry toward Chirico, who stole her heart.
> He has strong confidence and pride in the belief that PS are chosen beings, and believes that fighting and winning on the battlefield is his reason for existing.
> Built by studying and using Proto One's data, he was supposed to be the perfect warrior this time, but his love for Proto One remained as a psychological flaw.
> Even so, his astonishing combat ability overwhelms even Chirico and Fyana.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source has no pronoun for Epsilon; 'he' from glossary gender (male).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rochina
%4■Full Name■%1
Jean-Paul Rochina
%4■Profile■%1
> A mysterious man who keeps watch on Chirico, at times as an officer of Gilgamesh Army intelligence, at others as a commander of the Balarant Army.
> Officially, his mission is to recover the PS (Perfect Soldier) subject and to track Chirico, the clue to its whereabouts, but he seems to have other motives as well.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'subject'. | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army') (Balarant Army aligned); stiff 'works on the mission of recovering'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gregore
%4■Full Name■%1
Gregore Garosh
%4■Profile■%1
> Former senior master sergeant of the Red Shoulder unit.
> Like Chirico, he was judged unfit to be a Red Shoulder, and was supposed to be killed while in the unit under the guise of a mission.
> Seeking revenge on Pailsen, who took everything from him, he plots to act together with Chirico and the others.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'senior master sergeant' (glossary position text: 'senior sergeant major').

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Murza
%4■Full Name■%1
Murza Melyn
%4■Profile■%1
> A former corporal of the Red Shoulder unit, good with machinery.
> Like Chirico and the others, he was supposed to be killed while in the unit under the guise of a mission.
> He apparently leaked military secrets, and his whole family was slaughtered.
> Burning with vengeance against Pailsen as a result, he plots to act together with Gregore and the others.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp]: no explicit subject; read with Murza as subject (the topic). Possible alternative: 'apparently over a leak of military secrets'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Byman
%4■Full Name■%1
Byman Hagard
%4■Profile■%1
> A former corporal of the Red Shoulder unit, a proud cynic.
> Like Chirico and the others, he was supposed to be killed while in the unit under the guise of a mission.
> He lost his right arm at that time and now has a prosthetic one.
> Seeking revenge on Pailsen, who took everything from him, he plots to act together with Chirico and the others.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Carson
%4■Full Name■%1
Virgil Carson
%4■Profile■%1
> An intelligence spy planted in the Red Shoulders.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Pailsen
%4■Full Name■%1
Yoran Pailsen
%4■Profile■%1
> Founder of the Gilgamesh Army 24th Melkian Front Army 2045th Unit Strategic Armored Corps Special Mission Unit X-1, commonly known as the Red Shoulder unit.
> Aiming to create an ideal fighting force made up only of soldiers who do not die, he plots to use Chirico, who had shown an abnormally high survival rate.
> But Chirico's strangeness goes so far beyond even what Pailsen imagined that Pailsen begins to see Chirico as a threat to himself, and tries to eliminate him.
> After retiring from the army, he is involved with a mysterious organization in developing the PS (Perfect Soldier).
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] in the third paragraph alternates between Pailsen and Chirico; resolved by naming Chirico. | [editorial] tangled he/him sentence (tense clash, name repeated); referents kept explicit

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mellow
%4■Full Name■%1
Mellowlink Arity
%4■Profile■%1
> The sole survivor of the Schweps Platoon of the Plumbandor Armored Battalion, Gilgamesh Army 18th Melkian Front.
> He has an indomitable will to survive even if it means gnawing on rocks, and the strength never to give up even in hopeless situations.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. Schweps per glossary position text; [jp] romanized 'Plumbandor' (not in any glossary). | [editorial] glossary gender now known (Mellowlink male; accuracy flag)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Keek
%4■Full Name■%1
Keek Caradine
%4■Profile■%1
> An officer of Gilgamesh Army intelligence, with the rank of lieutenant junior grade.
> Keek seems to be tailing Mellowlink for some purpose, and sometimes even helps him out.
> Quite sharp, but Keek's true intentions are unknown.
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. [jp] = lieutenant (first lieutenant). | [editorial] style sheet: army names take capital A ('the Giganos Army', 'the Gilgamesh Army'); name repetition (Mellowlink male; Keek stays pronoun-free)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Jojo
%4■Full Name■%1
Joldy Vorder
%4■Profile■%1
> A brave boy with a strong sense of justice, though he tends to charge ahead recklessly.
> He was born the heir of the royal house of the Kingdom of Vorder, but shortly after his birth the country was taken by Mardoul's invasion.
> At that time he was rescued by the loyal retainer Azuves and was the only one to escape, but Azuves, fearing Mardoul's pursuit, raised him as his own grandson without ever telling him of his origins.
> Thanks to that upbringing, he grew into a strong, sturdy boy with an upright heart.
> By chance he discovered the iron giant Galient, and as its pilot he fights against Mardoul's army.
{x00}
rows.notes: Azuves from the sibling glossary. [jp] (sic) read as [jp] 'pursuit'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Slarzen
%4■Full Name■%1
Don Slarzen
%4■Profile■%1
> A former commander in Mardoul's army who led his band to join the White Valley side.
{x00}
rows.notes: White Valley from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mardoul
%4■Profile■%1
> A conqueror king who leads a mighty army with many Panzers, sweeping across Crescent.
> A mysterious figure who appeared out of nowhere at a certain point and rapidly expanded his power.
> He is in fact an alien from another planet, and intends to send the vitality called war into his homeland, which is ruled by science and has lost its vigor from growing too used to peace.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'Panzers' (one sibling glossary; another has 'armored soldier'). Crescent from the sibling glossary. | [editorial] repeated 'vitality' blurred the image (the vitality called war vs the vigor lost)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
High
%4■Full Name■%1
High Schultatte
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of Mardoul's Imperial Guard.
> He is proud, and because he regards himself and his fellow guards as privileged, he often acts on his own without orders.
> His loyalty to Mardoul, however, is genuine; whatever the order, he will carry it out even at the risk of his life.
> He is highly capable, but being still young he somewhat lacks flexibility.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] = 'Mardoul's Imperial Guard' per glossary position text (sibling: 'Mardoul Royal Guard'). | [editorial] unclear 'acts arbitrarily on his own'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ranvel
%4■Full Name■%1
Jilmzen Ranvel
%4■Profile■%1
> One of the foremost knights of Crescent, with ample ability and experience.
> A proud man with the soul of an old-fashioned warrior.
> He once belonged to Mardoul's army and was called "the strongest knight in Mardoul's army."
> But he was defeated by Jojo in single combat, and on learning that Jojo was the prince of the House of Vorder, which he had served before Mardoul's rule, he became Jojo's ally.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Eiji
%4■Full Name■%1
Albatro Null Eiji Asuka
%4■Profile■%1
> A child of mixed Earthling and Gradosian blood who appeared before Anna and the others to warn of the danger posed by the Grados Army's occupation policy.
> While fighting on as the Layzner's pilot, he learned the secret of Grados's creation, and became convinced that fighting was meaningless.
> He now carries on the fight with the Resistance to free the people under Grados occupation from oppression.
> He and Julia, known as the Saint of Cusco, are blood siblings.
{x00}
rows.notes: The JP full name is split over two lines; English fits on one. Albatro Null Eiji Asuka from the sibling glossary. | [accuracy] project decisions: [jp] = Gradosian, [jp] = the Grados Army | [editorial] 'keeps up the resistance as part of the Resistance' repetition

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Anna
%4■Full Name■%1
Anna Stephanie
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl resisting Grados rule as part of the Resistance.
> Though part of the Resistance, she does not fight with a gun; hers is a movement to protect culture and pride -- a resistance, so to speak, to keep even people's minds from being ruled.
> At 14, while taking part in a space experience school on Mars as a member of the UN's Cosmic Culture Club, she was caught up in the Grados invasion, and in the course of that fighting she met Eiji.
> She was the first to understand Eiji, and gradually came to be drawn to him.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] dangling apposition ('she protects... -- a resistance movement')

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Roanne
%4■Full Name■%1
Roanne Demitrich
%4■Profile■%1
> The Grados occupation army bureaucrat whom Le Caine trusts most.
> Extremely intelligent, and always calm and collected.
> He once took part in the space experience school together with Anna and the others, and during the Grados Army's invasion he was a comrade who fought alongside Eiji aboard an SPT.
> But after the Grados occupation, he betrayed those comrades and now works as a loyal subordinate to help occupation commander Le Caine build his ideal state, but...
{x00}
rows.notes: No gender in source or glossary: written without pronouns. | [accuracy] glossary/project gender: Roanne Demitrich is male (the draft note said no gender was known), so pronouns replace the repeated name; [jp] = the Grados Army | [editorial] stiff nominal 'cooperating in ... construction of an ideal state'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Julia
%4■Full Name■%1
Albatro Mill Julia Asuka
%4■Profile■%1
> The "Saint of Cusco."
> Holding firmly to nonviolence and proclaiming the futility of conflict, she urges the Grados Army to stop occupying by force and to coexist on equal terms.
> Eiji's elder sister by blood.
> During the fighting when the Grados Army invaded, her fiance was killed by her younger brother Eiji, and she once exchanged fire with him to avenge it.
> But she was captivated by the beauty of the planet Earth, and in the Cusco ruins at Nazca she learned the secret of Grados's creation and realized that fighting between the two sides was meaningless.
> Inside the ruins she also learned of the existence of the "Seal of Grados," an emergency evacuation device left by the ancient Gradosians to avert conflict between the two civilizations.
{x00}
rows.notes: The JP full name is split over two lines; English fits on one. [jp] rendered 'Seal of Grados'; [jp] 'the ancient Grados people'. Source places the Cusco ruins 'at Nazca' ([jp]); kept as written. | [accuracy] project decisions: [jp] = the Grados Army, [jp] = Gradosians | [editorial] ungrammatical 'appealing that'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Le Caine
%4■Profile■%1
> Son of Brigadier General Gresco, commander of the Grados Army, and commander of the occupation army.
> In Eiji's words, he is "a man who can't tell confidence from conceit"; though gifted with genius in every respect -- mind, skill and body -- his pride is abnormally high, surpassing even his talents.
> He seeks to destroy the cultures of occupied lands and correct them into the superior Grados culture.
> This is because he stubbornly believes the Gradosians to be the superior race, and is working toward building an ideal state by his own logic of rule: that being ruled by them is the very means to realize the ideal society.
> However, his ideas are not understood even by his own people, and as a result he walks the path of a dictator.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] project decisions: [jp] = the Grados Army, [jp] = Gradosians | [editorial] stiff 'has an abnormally high pride that exceeds even that'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gosterro
%4■Profile■%1
> A coward who will use any dirty means to reach his goals, and who loves bullying and killing.
> A member of the "Shiki Squad," a culture-destruction special forces unit under Le Caine.
> Three years ago he was defeated in battle with Eiji and hovered between life and death, but came back with most of his body mechanized.
> He was also once rejected after falling for Eiji's sister, Julia.
> For this reason he burns with a fierce vengeance -- one could call it a misplaced grudge -- against the siblings Eiji and Julia, and hounds them relentlessly.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] = 'Death Demon Squad' per sibling glossary (this glossary's position text: 'Shikitai (Death Squad)').

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Karla
%4■Full Name■%1
Karla Egiel
%4■Profile■%1
> On Brigadier General Gresco's orders, she has been assigned to eliminate the Layzner.
> Because she had feelings for the fiance of Julia (the Saint of Cusco), she bears hostility toward Julia out of jealousy, and toward Eiji out of hatred for killing him.
{x00}
rows.notes: No pronoun in source; 'she' from glossary gender (female). | [editorial] stiff 'assigned to the mission of eliminating'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gresco
%4■Profile■%1
> Supreme commander of the Grados Army's invasion force, and Le Caine's father.
> The very man who, though he knows the secret of Grados's creation, continues to rule people with overwhelming power.
> He plots to eliminate Eiji and the Layzner, who seek to pass on the secret of creation.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source writes [jp] in other rows and [jp] here; both rendered 'creation'. | [accuracy] project decision: [jp] = the Grados Army

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Roddy
%4■Full Name■%1
Roddy Shuffle
%4■Profile■%1
> An active boy who loves sports.
> Sensitive, with emotions more intense than most, he often charges ahead on his own judgment.
> He can be surprisingly stubborn and sometimes clashes with those around him, but his easygoing nature means he soon makes up again.
> To protect himself and the others, he reluctantly learned to pilot an RV (Round Vernian).
{x00}
rows.notes: Round Vernian from the sibling glossary.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Barts
%4■Full Name■%1
Barts Lyan
%4■Profile■%1
> Roddy's good partner, full of drive and playfulness.
> He taught himself how to pilot an RV (Round Vernian), and it was he who taught Roddy and the others.
> Oddly mature, he is calm and rational.
> Yet he is also perceptive about people's feelings and honest -- he is the one who holds the crew together.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Scott
%4■Full Name■%1
Scott Heyward
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of the deep-space training ship Janous.
> As the oldest member of the group, he was chosen as leader, and accepted reluctantly.
> Serious and responsible, he believes that having accepted, he must fulfill the role, and always tries hard to be a good leader, but he often ends up spinning his wheels.
> Still, he is only an adolescent boy, getting flustered around girls and throwing tantrums when things do not go his way.
> He has other flaws too, such as being overly cautious, but his sincere, thoughtful character has earned him the crew's complete trust as leader.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] spelled 'Janous' per sibling glossary (this glossary's ship entry has no English; position texts say 'Jayce/Janus' / 'Janus') -- needs a decision. [jp] rendered 'deep space'. | [editorial] awkward 'efforts spin their wheels' | [proofread] hyphenate compound modifier

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Fred
%4■Full Name■%1
Fred Shuffle
%4■Profile■%1
> Roddy Shuffle's younger brother.
> In contrast to his positive, active brother, he is timid and introverted.
> Devoted to his brother and quick to tears, he is always worrying about his optimistic, reckless brother.
> He is quick-witted and especially good with computers, and as an operator aboard the Janous he often assists Scott.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Guy
%4■Full Name■%1
Guy Shishioh
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of the GGG Mobile Unit.
> A hot-blooded man who has never given up, however tough the situation he was driven into, and has overcome it all with the power of courage.
> His body, once a cyborg's, was reborn through the guidance of the G-Stone as an Evoluder, a super-evolved human -- a bio-mechanical fusion being that transcends both living things and machines.
> He looks no different from a human, but has combat ability greater than a cyborg's.
> In battle he equips (dons) the ID Armor, a special armored suit.
> His only weapon is a dagger called the Will Knife.
> Through the guidance of the G-Stone, he performs Final Fusion to form GaoGaiGar and GaoFighGar.
{x00}
rows.notes: Readings dropped: ([jp] [jp]), GGG[jp]. G-Stone, Final Fusion from the sibling glossary; Evoluder per glossary position text. [jp] rendered 'equips (dons)'.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mamoru
%4■Full Name■%1
Mamoru Amami
%4■Real Name■%1
Ratio
%4■Profile■%1
> A brave boy: cheerful, energetic and kind, yet ready to throw himself boldly into danger for everyone's sake.
> "Ratio of the Green Planet."
> He was entrusted to the Amami couple by Galeon, the mechanical lion that escaped from the Green Planet, and was raised with their love.
> He has the power to "purify" people who have been turned into Zonders.
> After the defeat of the 31 Machine Primevals, who sought to subject the world to Machine Sublimation, he set out on a journey to save people on other planets who might still be suffering at the hands of the new Machine Species.
> However, when a great crisis struck once again, he came back together with Galeon.
> Before setting out, he and his childhood friend Hana held a wedding.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Ratio (also seen as "Latio"), [jp] Galeon, [jp] Zonder, [jp] 31 Machine Primevals, [jp] Machine Sublimation, [jp] new Machine Species, [jp] "purify". [jp] rendered "Hana" (honorific -chan dropped). | [editorial] flow: 'he held a wedding with' reads stiffly

rows.en:
%4■Known As■%1
Hana
%4■Full Name■%1
Hana Hatsuno
%4■Profile■%1
> The only daughter of Kitchen HANA, and Mamoru's childhood friend.
> An honest, kind and earnest girl, but she gives in easily when pushed and tends to get swept along.
> Just as they had promised when she was five, the two held a wedding and she officially became his "wife," but he then left for space alone, and she is faithfully waiting for him to return.
> Since then she has grown a little taller, but as ever she is dragged around by her pet dog Joseph and its puppies.
> She also still seems to run into incidents whenever she is out and about.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label [jp] = "Known As". Dog [jp] romanized "Joseph" (hiragana spelling of the name). "Kitchen HANA" kept as in source (no added gloss). | [accuracy] [jp] = officially / at last, not "happily" | [editorial] doubled 'easily'; 'she held a wedding' -> the two held it (matches #161)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mikoto
%4■Full Name■%1
Mikoto Utsugi
%4■Profile■%1
> An operator assigned to GGG's Mobile Unit.
> She handles communications with and support for Guy, GaoGaiGar and GaoFighGar.
> She and Guy were classmates in high school, and the two are sweethearts.
> Shy and quick to tears, yet strong at heart, innocent and plucky, she always worries about Guy as he fights on the front line and supports him emotionally.
{x00}
rows.notes: GGG reading [jp] (Three G) dropped like a name reading.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Swan
%4■Full Name■%1
Swan White
%4■Profile■%1
> An operator assigned to GGG's Research Division.
> She also served as assistant to Dr. Leo Shishioh, Guy's father and GGG's supervisor and head of research and development.
> Talented and beautiful, she is an attractive woman who brightens up everyone around her.
> She speaks dubious Japanese with an English accent.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: romanized "Leo Shishioh" (surname per glossary Guy Shishioh).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Renais
%4■Full Name■%1
Renais Cardiff Shishioh
%4■Profile■%1
> An agent of Chasseur, France's special-crimes task force, she goes by the epithet "Lion Reine" (Lion Queen).
> She is Guy Shishioh's younger cousin.
> An enhanced cyborg with a G-Stone in her right hand, she is skilled with all kinds of weapons.
> The coat she always wears is a bulletproof intercooler coat; it serves as a cooling device, venting heat from her body, which overheats easily.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Chasseur, [jp] "Lion Reine", [jp] G-Stone. [jp] rendered "special-crimes task force".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Commander Taiga
%4■Full Name■%1
Kotaro Taiga
%4■Profile■%1
> Current president of the Space Development Agency and former commander of GGG.
> Elegant, dashing and a kind-hearted gentleman toward women, he still enjoys the strong trust of his former subordinates thanks to his sound judgment and the great respect he commands.
> After the defeat of the 31 Machine Primevals, who sought to subject the world to Machine Sublimation, he stepped down as GGG's supreme commander.
> GGG is a UN defense organization for maintaining and restoring order; the name stands for Gutsy Galaxy Guard.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] in its Japanese sense (chivalrous toward women) rendered "a gentleman toward women". [jp] rendered "Space Development Agency". | [proofread] capitalisation: generic title lowercase, matching "supreme commander" and "president" in the same entry

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Katori
%4■Full Name■%1
Yutaro Katori
%4■Profile■%1
> Captain of the Space Patrol, who came in pursuit of Draias, the self-proclaimed Space Emperor.
> This form, however, is an android built by Dr. Amano that he, a cosmic life form, has merged with.
> Normally he wears glasses to hide his true identity and lives as the doctor's assistant.
> A gentle person, pure-hearted and with a strong sense of justice, he cannot tolerate wrongdoing or anything crooked.
> He is also very curious, and since he knows little of Earth's common sense and customs, he is forever saying and doing outlandish things that baffle Haruka and Kenta.
> And perhaps because he first tried to learn the language from period dramas, he often lapses into an old-fashioned way of speaking, such as when fighting villains.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Draias, [jp] "Space Patrol". | [editorial] stiff relative clause smoothed

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Dr. Amano
%4■Full Name■%1
Hiroshi Amano
%4■Profile■%1
> A self-proclaimed genius scientist and director of the Amano Peace Science Laboratory.
> The doctor does have a brain worthy of the name, yet goes unrecognized by the world, perhaps because of a constant stream of bizarre inventions.
> Having noticed the growth of evil energy with a self-built "Minus Energy Detector," Dr. Amano had been researching and developing all sorts of machines to keep the world from falling under the rule of darkness.
> Incidentally, the research funds apparently came from selling a mountain the doctor owned, but since the taxes went unpaid, Dr. Amano is afraid of anyone seeing inside the laboratory.
{x00}
rows.notes: Pun kept implicit: his given name [jp] (Hiroshi) is written with the kanji for "doctor"; "worthy of his name" translates [jp] literally. [jp] rendered "Amano Peace Science Laboratory" (not in glossary). | [accuracy] pronouns removed: no gender in source or glossary ([jp] [jp] gender blank); [jp] kept open as "the name" | [editorial] name-repetition workaround smoothed (gender still blank, no pronoun)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Haruka
%4■Full Name■%1
Haruka Amano
%4■Profile■%1
> Dr. Amano's granddaughter, a fourth-grader and Kenta's cousin.
> She loves looking after others and is a capable girl who handles all the housework at the Amano Peace Science Laboratory.
> She designed Katori's appearance as her ideal man.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] stiff 'something she designed' construction

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kenta
%4■Full Name■%1
Kenta Amano
%4■Profile■%1
> Dr. Amano's grandson, a fourth-grader and Haruka's cousin.
> A curious, energetic and active boy.
> He is a good partner who supports Yutaro, who knows little about how things work on Earth.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] ambiguous 'he' (Kenta or Yutaro) resolved as in source

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Dr. Yoshiko
%4■Full Name■%1
Yoshiko Kunieda
%4■Profile■%1
> A doctor with the Red Cross.
> When Katori happened to come in to donate blood, his blood test produced a reaction that should normally be impossible, and she became interested in him.
> But she was gradually drawn to the kind, pure-hearted Katori, and after learning his true identity she began visiting the Amano Peace Science Laboratory to help out.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Inspector Satsuda
%4■Profile■%1
> A self-proclaimed crack inspector of the Metropolitan Police Department.
> Suspecting Dr. Amano of being the culprit behind a 3-billion-yen robbery, he barges into the Amano Peace Science Laboratory at every opportunity to investigate.
> He goes overboard like that at times, but his sense of justice is genuine, and after learning Katori's true identity he too fights hard to help Katori in his mission.
{x00}
rows.notes: Name-line reading ([jp]) dropped.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Maito
%4■Full Name■%1
Maito Senpuuji
%4■Profile■%1
> President of the Senpuuji Concern, one of the world's leading corporations, and leader of the Brave Express Team.
> Very rich, brilliant, good at every sport and handsome, he can pull off flashy poses and smooth lines -- a picture-perfect hero.
> A nice guy brimming with justice, courage and drive, with a kindness that will not let him ignore the weak.
> The Brave Express Team is an organization founded by Maito's father, Asahi Senpuuji, to oppose a "great evil" he learned of while traveling the world.
> Asahi lost his life, along with his wife Ruriko, in an accident of unknown cause.
> His will, however, was taken up by his son Maito, who fights on for justice every day, crossing borders to save the people of the world from the hands of evil.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Senpuuji Concern, [jp] Brave Express Team, [jp] Asahi Senpuuji, [jp] Ruriko. | [editorial] 'That father' unidiomatic

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Sally
%4■Full Name■%1
Sally Yoshinaga
%4■Profile■%1
> A plucky girl who always keeps smiling and works hard with a positive attitude, no matter how tough things get.
> She has a younger brother, Tetsuya, and the two live with their father as a family of three.
> Her father is ill and cannot work, so in his place she is always working part-time jobs here and there to help support the household.
> For some reason she often happens to be where incidents occur, and Maito has rescued her countless times.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Izumi
%4■Full Name■%1
Izumi Matsubara
%4■Profile■%1
> Secretary to the president of the Senpuuji Concern, which Maito heads, and operator for the Brave Express Team.
> When Maito abandons his busy duties as president to rush off with the Brave Express Team, she juggles his schedule so that business is not disrupted.
> To Maito she is not only a capable secretary but also something like an older sister.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] clause order: purpose clause was stranded after a long relative clause

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Gaine
%4■Profile■%1
> Leader of the Brave Express Team's robots.
> A humanoid robot equipped with a Super AI, it even has a personality of its own.
> For high-speed travel, Gaine can transform into a train form based on the Tokaido Shinkansen Nozomi.
> Gaine also combines with the Locomorizer and Might Wing to form Might Gaine.
> Earnest, upright and sincere by nature.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source uses no pronoun for Gaine; "it" used for the robot and the name repeated elsewhere. Not in glossary: [jp] Locomorizer, [jp] Might Wing, [jp] Super AI.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hamada
%4■Full Name■%1
Mitsuhiko Hamada
%4■Profile■%1
> Maito's childhood friend and best friend.
> In contrast to Maito, who acts on instinct, Hamada thinks things through using theories based on data.
> As strategist, Hamada is the Brave Express Team's indispensable brain, and in battle supports Maito by handling enemy data analysis and the like.
> Aspiring to become a manga artist someday, Hamada has put that design sense to use in such things as designing the Bombers' animal modes.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered "the Bombers" (not in glossary). | [accuracy] pronouns removed: no gender in source or glossary ([jp] gender blank) | [editorial] name-repetition workaround smoothed (gender blank); 'that design sense' had no referent

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Tetsuya
%4■Full Name■%1
Tetsuya Yoshinaga
%4■Profile■%1
> Sally Yoshinaga's younger brother.
> A huge fan of Might Gaine, he believes in Might Gaine's heart of justice.
> He is cheerful, energetic and straightforward.
> He also shows concern for his sister, who has had to go to work because of their father's illness.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Chief Osaka
%4■Full Name■%1
Jirou Osaka
%4■Profile■%1
> Factory chief of the Senpuuji Concern's Aoto Factory.
> Chief Osaka handles repairs, maintenance and even development for the Brave Express Team; without the chief, the team could not function.
> A born engineer whose craftsman's dedication has earned the admiration of Maito and the others, who call the chief "the Aoto Factory Chief."
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Aoto Factory" (not in glossary). | [accuracy] pronouns removed: no gender in source or glossary ([jp] [jp] gender blank); [jp] (because of the craftsman's work) restored | [editorial] name-repetition workaround smoothed (gender blank); 'this person' / dangling 'which'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Joe
%4■Full Name■%1
Joe Rival
%4■Alias■%1
Ace Joe
%4■Real Name■%1
Joe Shishido
%4■Profile■%1
> Maito's greatest rival, appearing sometimes as an enemy and sometimes as an ally.
> A former ace pilot of the regular army, second to none at piloting robots.
> Now, however, Joe has deserted the regular army and is on the run.
> Acknowledging Maito and Might Gaine as rivals, Joe aims to fight them fair and square and win.
> With absolute pride in those skills, Joe is above using dirty tricks.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header labels: [jp] "Alias", [jp] "Real Name". Not in glossary: [jp] "Ace Joe", [jp] [jp] "Joe Shishido". | [accuracy] pronouns removed: no gender in source or glossary ([jp] [jp] gender blank) | [editorial] name repeated in four straight paragraphs (gender blank); one dropped to reference fragment

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
En
%4■Full Name■%1
En Daidoji
%4■Profile■%1
> A first-year at Sankai High School.
> An optimist and a hot-blooded guy who is impulsiveness personified.
> Put kindly, he is fearless; put unkindly, he is thoughtless, sloppy and rude.
> He is tough in a fight and a good guy who cannot leave anyone in trouble alone, but his simple-minded failure to think ahead sometimes causes problems.
> He hates studying and is a habitual truant and latecomer.
> He transforms into Fire En and calls himself the leader of Dagwon.
> "This is what youth is all about!"
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Sankai High School"; [jp] "Dagwon" (not in glossary as such).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kai
%4■Full Name■%1
Kai Hirose
%4■Profile■%1
> A second-year at Sankai High School.
> The fearsome head of the disciplinary committee: he hates anything crooked to an extreme and mercilessly cracks down on anyone who disturbs order, using the bamboo sword he always carries.
> Brilliant, accomplished in both studies and martial arts, and handsome, he is flawless on paper, but his excessive fastidiousness is the one fly in the ointment.
> His strictness and cool, composed manner give no hint of weakness, but cockroaches are the one thing he cannot stand.
> He transforms into Turbo Kai and serves as Dagwon's strategist.
> "Don't say, four or five! (No ifs or buts!)"
{x00}
rows.notes: Catchphrase is his literal English rendering of [jp]; English part kept as written, the Japanese gloss in parentheses translated as "No ifs or buts!".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Shin
%4■Full Name■%1
Shin Sawamura
%4■Profile■%1
> A second-year at Sankai High School.
> Captain of the judo club and good at every sport.
> A flirtatious ladies' man, he is always fooling around with the girls of the volleyball club, the tennis club and others, under the pretext of coaching them.
> Wherever he goes he gets along well with girls, but when it comes to actually dating, he seems to get dumped every time.
> He transforms into Armor Shin.
> "Youth is all about having a blast with the girls!"
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Yoku
%4■Full Name■%1
Yoku Kazamatsuri
%4■Profile■%1
> A second-year at Sankai High School.
> The top student in the school and an observation maniac in the biology club.
> His mania is thoroughgoing, and his interests range indiscriminately from microorganisms such as mold all the way to aliens.
> So much so that one wonders whether he started acting as a member of Dagwon because the missions combine hobby and practical benefit.
> He has something of the mad scientist about him; his interest is confined to rare creatures he can observe, and does not seem to extend much to human girls.
> Gentle and averse to conflict, he handles scientific analysis for Dagwon.
> He transforms into Wing Yoku.
> "I wonder if I can get a specimen..."
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Ryu
%4■Full Name■%1
Ryu Hashiba
%4■Profile■%1
> A first-year at Sankai High School.
> Extremely taciturn and expressionless, nothing ever fazes him.
> He prefers to be alone and does not care to associate much with people, but he does like being with animals, and animals take to him readily.
> Apart from the fact that he has a sick younger sister, his private life is shrouded in mystery, and no one knows the truth about him.
> Apparently he lives in the woods on the school grounds and makes his living from part-time jobs, but...
> Within Dagwon he handles covert operations.
> He transforms into Shadow Ryu.
> "I hate people meddling in my affairs..."
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Geki
%4■Full Name■%1
Geki Kuroiwa
%4■Profile■%1
> A third-year at Fuun High School.
> Not too bright, but full of loyalty and compassion -- a manly gang boss of the good old-fashioned type.
> He has as many as 100 followers, who look up to him.
> Simple-minded and prone to jumping to conclusions, he sometimes goes off and does strange things.
> He and En used to be rivals in brawling, but the two seem to get along surprisingly well, and now they are something like sparring buddies.
> He transforms into Drill Geki, the most powerful member of Dagwon.
> "Leave it to me!"
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Fuun High School, [jp] "Drill Geki" (pattern of Fire En / Turbo Kai). [jp] rendered "gang boss". | [accuracy] hedge restored: [jp] = "seem to get along" | [editorial] 'rivals in fighting' unidiomatic

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Rai
%4■Full Name■%1
Rai Utsumi
%4■Profile■%1
> A mysterious boy who transferred into the first year at Sankai High School.
> In truth he is a rookie detective from the planet Jinrai, sent as a trainee by the Space Police Organization.
> He is honest, pure-hearted and always gives it his all, but he is still very inexperienced and scatterbrained.
> The seventh and final member to join Dagwon, he calls En and the others "senpai" and looks up to them.
> He has not quite adjusted to life on Earth and sometimes does absurd things.
> He has psychic powers and transforms into Thunder Rai.
> "Let's do our best again today!"
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] planet Jinrai, [jp] Space Police Organization. [jp] kept as "senpai".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Alter Crystal
%4■Profile■%1
> A mysterious Alter whose right arm is black and left arm is white.
> Everything about it, including what drives its actions, is unknown; about all that is known is that it is a powerful Alter.
{x00}
rows.notes: Reading line ([jp]) under the name dropped, per the rule for name readings.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Jin
%4■Full Name■%1
Jin Hyuga
%4■Profile■%1
> The main pilot of Raijin-Oh, a cheerful, energetic leader of the neighborhood kids.
> He is good at physical activities but bad at studying, and gets nothing but failing marks on tests.
> A simple-minded boy with a foul mouth, but warm at heart.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered "leader of the neighborhood kids".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Asuka
%4■Full Name■%1
Asuka Tsukishiro
%4■Profile■%1
> With top grades, a talent for every sport, good looks and a rich family besides, he is something of an idol to the girls in his class.
> Usually cool and self-confident, he also has the side of an ordinary boy who loses his nerve when cornered.
> He serves as a sub-pilot of Raijin-Oh.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Koji
%4■Full Name■%1
Koji Hoshiyama
%4■Profile■%1
> Kind-hearted with a timid side, he is surprisingly strong when it counts, breaking through tight spots with courage and guts.
> He loves mysteries, and his hobby is searching for UFOs.
> He serves as a sub-pilot of Raijin-Oh.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Maria
%4■Full Name■%1
Maria Shiratori
%4■Profile■%1
> Class representative and commander of the Earth Defense Class.
> With a strong sense of responsibility, plenty of drive and real leadership, she leads everyone in the Earth Defense Class.
> She is strong-willed and can be pushy, but she also has the honesty to apologize right away when she is in the wrong.
> She and Jin have a "the more they fight, the closer they are" relationship; they are friends who are always squabbling.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Cookie
%4■Full Name■%1
Yoko Kuriki
%4■Profile■%1
> In charge of radar monitoring for the Earth Defense Class.
> An innocent, clingy girl who tends to lean on others right away.
> She is self-conscious about being short and more childish than her age.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Yu
%4■Full Name■%1
Yu Izumi
%4■Profile■%1
> In charge of checking Raijin-Oh's combination.
> Shy and quiet, she was never able to act very assertively, but as she works as a member of the Earth Defense Class, she grows confident in herself.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source uses no pronoun; "she" from the glossary entry (gender: female).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hidenori
%4■Full Name■%1
Hidenori Kondo
%4■Profile■%1
> In charge of radar monitoring for the Earth Defense Class.
> The son of a wealthy family.
> Easygoing and a little timid, but he also has the courage to step up when the Earth Defense Class is in a pinch.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Tsutomu
%4■Full Name■%1
Tsutomu Kojima
%4■Profile■%1
> Computer operator of the Earth Defense Class.
> The top student in the class, he also serves as the Earth Defense Class's strategist.
> Extremely meticulous and full of curiosity, he is always studying Raijin-Oh.
> His knowledge has saved the Earth Defense Class from tight spots many times.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source uses no pronoun; "he" from the glossary entry (gender: male).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Love
%4■Full Name■%1
Aiko Shimada
%4■Profile■%1
> Monitors the various sensor systems for the Earth Defense Class.
> She has a strong sense of responsibility and is cool and composed, but she is also passionate at heart, with "special training" as her hobby.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source uses no pronoun; "she" from the glossary entry (gender: female).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Mr. Shinoda
%4■Full Name■%1
Shuntaro Shinoda
%4■Profile■%1
> Homeroom teacher of Class 5-3 at Yosho Academy, also known as the Earth Defense Class.
> He can be a bit dim, but he is a passionate teacher who cares deeply for his students, cheering on and helping the students of the Earth Defense Class.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Yosho Academy" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ms. Himeki
%4■Full Name■%1
Ruruko Himeki
%4■Profile■%1
> School nurse at Yosho Academy, home of the Earth Defense Class.
> Very laid-back, but gentle and mild-natured, and a good friend who understands the children of the Earth Defense Class.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Commander Takeda
%4■Profile■%1
> Commander of the Defense Force.
> A hardheaded person who resents children poking their noses into adult business.
> Always domineering, Takeda sneers at the Earth Defense Class and the Ganbar Team as nothing but children playing, yet is not much use against powerful enemies.
{x00}
rows.notes: Name-line reading ([jp]) dropped. [jp] rendered "Defense Force". | [accuracy] gender removed: source says [jp], glossary gender blank

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Kotaro
%4■Full Name■%1
Kotaro Kirigakure
%4■Profile■%1
> A fourth-grader at Aozora Elementary School who transforms into Yellow Ganbar with the Ganbar Brace.
> A descendant of ninja, he is learning ninjutsu from his father Tobei, but keeps skipping practice.
> Irresponsible and lazy, and a mischievous little rascal on top of that.
> He gets too carried away and often causes trouble as a result, but gets through it with his natural nerve.
> Banana daifuku is his favorite food, and he seems to treasure it more than his Ganbar Brace.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] "Ganbar Brace" (spelled to match Ganbar Team), [jp] Aozora Elementary School, [jp] Tobei.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Yellow Ganbar
%4■Real Name■%1
Kotaro Kirigakure
%4■Profile■%1
> The transformed form of Kotaro Kirigakure, a member of the Ganbar Team.
> Each Ganbar Suit has a different psychic power, and Yellow Ganbar can move at super speed.
> Being a show-off, he sometimes uses this talent for pranks, but he also puts it to work saving people caught up in all kinds of incidents.
> Main pilot of Gambaruger.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] "Ganbar Suit" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Yosuke
%4■Full Name■%1
Yosuke Kazamatsuri
%4■Profile■%1
> A fourth-grader at Aozora Elementary School who transforms into Blue Ganbar with the Ganbar Brace.
> He is bad at sports but gets good grades, and is quiet by nature.
> Because his mother is so devoted to his education, he is made to attend cram school, violin lessons and more, and leads the busiest life of anyone on the Ganbar Team.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Blue Ganbar
%4■Real Name■%1
Yosuke Kazamatsuri
%4■Profile■%1
> The transformed form of Yosuke Kazamatsuri, a member of the Ganbar Team.
> Each Ganbar Suit has a psychic power, and Blue Ganbar's sight and hearing become extremely keen.
> With this ability he does things like locating enemies and probing their weak points, serving as the team's analyst.
> He is a sub-pilot of Gambaruger.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Rikiya
%4■Full Name■%1
Rikiya Ryuzaki
%4■Profile■%1
> A fourth-grader at Aozora Elementary School who transforms into Red Ganbar with the Ganbar Brace.
> He is earnest, kind and dependable, with a strong sense of justice.
> For that reason he cannot stand lazy Kotaro's attitude, and the two often end up fighting.
> His family runs a ramen shop called "Gyakuten Ramen," and he is a dutiful son who often helps out there.
> He bats cleanup for the local youth baseball team, the "Aozora Genkies," and dreams of becoming a pro baseball player.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] "Gyakuten Ramen" and [jp] "Aozora Genkies" romanized (not in glossary). [jp] rendered "bats cleanup".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Red Ganbar
%4■Real Name■%1
Rikiya Ryuzaki
%4■Profile■%1
> The transformed form of Rikiya Ryuzaki, a member of the Ganbar Team.
> Each Ganbar Suit has a psychic power; Red Ganbar boasts tremendous strength and uses it to help people caught up in all kinds of incidents.
> He is a sub-pilot of Gambaruger.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Hokuto
%4■Full Name■%1
Hokuto Kusanagi
%4■Profile■%1
> A pilot of Dendoh.
> A student in Class 5-1 at Hoshimi Elementary School.
> An intellectual type who knows his way around computers and other machines, he is also good at sports.
> A model student by temperament, and popular in his class.
> He can be so cautious that he seems indecisive, but when it counts he is strong at heart.
> His personality is the complete opposite of Ginga's, and they often quarrel, but they get along and are perfectly in sync -- a great pair.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Hoshimi Elementary School" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ginga
%4■Full Name■%1
Ginga Izumo
%4■Profile■%1
> A pilot of Dendoh.
> A student in Class 5-1 at Hoshimi Elementary School.
> Hot-blooded and impulsive, the type whose body moves before his head does.
> Fiercely competitive, quick to decide and upbeat, but fragile once his spirit breaks.
> A huge fan of Yuki Sugo of the idol group "C-Drive."
> His personality is the complete opposite of Hokuto's, and they often quarrel, but they get along and are perfectly in sync -- a great pair.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] "Yuki Sugo" (surname per glossary [jp] Sugo); [jp] "C-Drive". | [editorial] 'spirit' repeated in one sentence

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Elise
%4■Full Name■%1
Elise Willamette
%4■Profile■%1
> A child prodigy who came from GEAR America to GEAR headquarters in Japan as chief researcher for the analysis of the Data Weapons.
> Earnest and responsible, she is kind and loves animals.
> In Japan she transferred into Hokuto and Ginga's class, but in fact she has already graduated from university.
> So she seems to consider herself a full-fledged adult, but she gets worked up and angry over things like cake; at heart she is still a child, as befits her age.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] GEAR, [jp] Data Weapons.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Vega
%4■Real Name (?)■%1
Orie Kusanagi
%4■Profile■%1
> Vice-commander of GEAR, the Earth defense organization.
> She always hides her identity behind a mask, and few even within GEAR know her secret.
> She apparently knew of Galfa's existence and coming invasion from the start, and had prepared GEAR and Dendoh as countermeasures.
> Her costume and weapons look dubious at first glance, but in fact they make full use of the latest technology.
> In truth she is Hokuto's mother, Orie Kusanagi, and also a princess of the planet Arktos who escaped alone from Galfa's clutches.
{x00}
rows.notes: New header label [jp] "Real Name (?)". [jp] not in glossary: romanized "Arktos" (glossary notes elsewhere use both Arktos and Arcturus -- needs one decision). GEAR reading [jp] dropped. | [proofread] term: project decision [jp] = Vice-Commander (machine library and dialogue already say vice-commander for Vega)

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Arthea
%4■Profile■%1
> Arthea, with his mask removed and his memories restored.
> A member of the royal family of the planet Arktos, which was taken over by Galfa, and Vega's older brother.
> He now belongs to GEAR, serving as battle commander among other roles.
> Cool, composed and earnest.
> Strict but not stiff, he is surprisingly approachable and has a sense of humor.
> He bears a guilt he can never atone for, having wiped out life on many planets during his time as the Black Knight under Galfa's control.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Orie
%4■Full Name■%1
Orie Kusanagi
%4■Real Name■%1
Vega
%4■Profile■%1
> Hokuto's gentle, easygoing mother.
> A home-loving woman and a fine cook, she currently runs a coffee shop on the ground floor of her home.
> In fact she is both clever and athletic -- none other than Vega, vice-commander of the Earth defense organization GEAR, a masked housewife fighting Galfa.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] [jp] kept as "Real Name: Vega" as written. [jp] rendered "homely woman" (domestic sense). | [accuracy] "homely" reads as "plain-looking" (US); [jp] = home-loving / domestic | [proofread] term: project decision [jp] = Vice-Commander, matches #210 and machine library

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hokuto's Father
%4■Full Name■%1
Keisuke Kusanagi
%4■Profile■%1
> Hokuto's father.
> An announcer in the news department of the Nitto TV network.
> His work keeps him busy, but on his days off he never fails to devote himself to his beloved wife and son -- a good dad.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Nitto TV" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Ginga's Father
%4■Full Name■%1
Genichi Izumo
%4■Profile■%1
> Ginga's father.
> A crack journalist who flies all over the world.
> A sharp man with deep insight and keen powers of deduction who has landed many scoops, he quickly figured out who Dendoh's pilots were (Hokuto and Ginga), a secret kept from all but a few even at GEAR headquarters.
> But though he seems frivolous, he is a sensible adult with a sense of restraint, and did not carelessly let the secret out.
> Highly adaptable and easily influenced, he speaks oddly for a while after returning from an assignment, mixing in the local language of the region.
{x00}
rows.notes: [editorial] dangling modifier

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Otome
%4■Full Name■%1
Otome Izumo
%4■Profile■%1
> Ginga's younger sister.
> A cute child who, despite her baby lisp, mimics the way the people around her talk.
> She calls Ginga "Gin-nii" and adores him.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] kept as "Gin-nii" (affectionate "big brother Gin").

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Meteo
%4■Profile■%1
> The main computer of the spaceship "Meteo," which brought Vega from Arktos.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Commander Shibuya
%4■Profile■%1
> Commander of GEAR, the Earth defense organization.
> Holds a 3rd dan in kendo, a 2nd dan in judo and a 3rd dan in calligraphy.
> Mild-mannered, yet in an emergency Shibuya does not hesitate to issue harsh orders as commander.
> A capable commander with a flexible mind who can make sound judgments without getting emotional.
{x00}
rows.notes: Name-line reading ([jp]) dropped. | [accuracy] gender removed: source says [jp], glossary gender blank | [editorial] 'Commander' four times in four lines (gender blank); first repeat dropped to reference fragment

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Black Knight Arthea
%4■Profile■%1
> A Galfa pilot who operates Knight Ouga.
> A flesh-and-blood human, which is extremely rare within the Machine Empire Galfa.
> A member of the Imperial Guard of Galfa's home planet, he came here on orders from the Emperor to search for the Data Weapons.
> Cool and composed, he not only has piloting skills that keep Hokuto and the others at bay but also excels at hand-to-hand combat.
> He always wears a mask, and it seems his memories have been sealed by that mask, but...
{x00}
rows.notes: Reading line ([jp]) under the name dropped. [jp] rendered "Knight Ouga" from its reading [jp] ([jp] Ouga per glossary). | [editorial] 'pilot who pilots'; 'its Emperor' referent unclear

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Zero
%4■Profile■%1
> Zero has the fighting power to wipe out GEAR bases everywhere single-handedly.
> Outwardly he looks like a flesh-and-blood human, but in truth he is a terminal and alter ego that lets Emperor Galfa move freely about the outside world.
> Unless Emperor Galfa's main body and this alter ego are destroyed at the same time, he revives and regenerates endlessly.
{x00}
rows.notes: Source has no subject in the first line or pronoun anywhere; the name is repeated and "it" used for the regenerating alter ego. | [editorial] glossary gives Zero male: pronoun workaround smoothed, it/he made consistent

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Zero
%4■Profile■%1
> The mightiest Machine Knight in the Machine Empire Galfa, and Galfa's assault squad leader.
> In truth he is a terminal and alter ego that lets Emperor Galfa move freely about the outside world.
> Unless Emperor Galfa's main body and this alter ego are destroyed at the same time, he revives and regenerates endlessly.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] (a pun on [jp] "knight") rendered "Machine Knight". [jp] rendered "assault squad leader". | [editorial] glossary gives Zero male: consistent with #219

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Emperor Galfa
%4■Profile■%1
> Emperor of the Machine Empire Galfa.
> Originally it was a computer that managed the entire natural environment of the planet Arktos.
> Over a long time it came to have a will of its own, and while watching the humans who lived under its management, it began to think of them as something like parasites that could not live without its power.
> Then, when it became aware of its own enormous power, it proclaimed itself king of the planet and king of the universe, eliminated the humans and began building an empire of machines.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Roger
%4■Full Name■%1
Roger Smith
%4■Profile■%1
> The negotiator said to be the most trustworthy in Paradigm City.
> Formerly an investigator with the Military Police, he quit after a certain incident, and his relations with them are now somewhat strained.
> A gentleman who treats women, children and the elderly kindly, but he is hard on criminals, on those who break promises and on those without professional pride.
> He is the only Dominus (pilot) who can operate Big O, but even he does not know why he is able to pilot it.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] rendered "negotiator" (the gloss duplicates it), [jp] Dominus. [jp] rendered "strained" with "somewhat".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
R. Dorothy
%4■Full Name■%1
R. Dorothy Wayneright
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl-type android who came to live and work at Roger's mansion after a certain incident.
> She is not a combat android, so her fighting power is limited, but she still has far greater physical abilities than an ordinary human.
> She is a machine, but she apparently has something like emotions, which on very rare occasions come to the surface.
> She speaks cynically and acts with arrogant disregard for others, but she also has a cute side: she worries about her weight, which is far heavier than she looks.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Dastun
%4■Full Name■%1
Dan Dastun
%4■Profile■%1
> Chief investigator of the Military Police and Roger's former superior.
> He takes pride in the Military Police's work of protecting the citizens, even though it is merely one division of the Paradigm Corporation.
> Still, he privately has doubts about head-office policies, such as not protecting the people outside the Domes.
> He also feels bitter shame at how powerless he and his men are against destroyers of overwhelming power such as the Megadeuses.
> Even so, guided by his own convictions, he works tirelessly to do what he and his men can for the safety of the citizens.
> Ever since the incident that led Roger to leave the Military Police, the two have been at odds, but he personally still cares about Roger.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Megadeus. [jp] rendered "chief investigator". | [editorial] 'it' before its referent; clumsy 'does all he can ... what they are able to'

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Beck
%4■Full Name■%1
Jason Beck
%4■Profile■%1
> A criminal who is forever stirring up trouble in Paradigm City.
> He has been caught and sent to prison many times, but each time he gets out he goes right back to crime, undeterred.
> He does seem to have an aesthetic of sorts, however, and never uses the same method twice.
> He was also the ringleader of the incident that brought R. Dorothy to Roger: the kidnapping of the Soldano family's daughter (Dorothy).
> Defeated by Roger and Big O on that occasion and arrested by the Military Police, he came to hate Roger and to plot revenge.
> Always hyper, he is a dandy known mostly for his bizarre behavior, but contrary to appearances he is very sharp when it comes to crime.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Soldano" (not in glossary). | [editorial] stiff phrasing ('Soldano daughter', 'Having been beaten ... at that time')

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Alex
%4■Full Name■%1
Alex Rosewater
%4■Profile■%1
> The second president of the Paradigm Corporation, reigning as the de facto ruler of Paradigm City.
> The man who enclosed Paradigm City within domes and built it up into something like a nation of its own.
> But his methods are high-handed, and there seem to be some who resent him even within the company.
> He is the son of Chairman Gordon Rosewater, who built the Paradigm Corporation in a single generation and now lives in retirement, and he has a complex about wanting to surpass his great father.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] "Gordon Rosewater" (not in glossary; surname per Alex Rosewater).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Yu
%4■Full Name■%1
Yu Isami
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy whose parents are researchers of Organic Machines such as the Brain Powerd.
> But by the time he was old enough to remember, his parents had left him with his grandmother and gone off to devote themselves to their research.
> When his parents finally came for him, it was only because they saw in him the makings of research material, and that only deepened Yu's feeling of having been abandoned by them.
> Perhaps because of that upbringing, for a while after running away from his parents he was a bitter boy, conspicuous for his selfish, self-righteous behavior.
> But at heart he is honest and kind, and while living with Hime and the others he gradually regains his true self and grows as a person.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Brain Powerd, [jp] Organic Machine.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hime
%4■Full Name■%1
Hime Utsumiya
%4■Profile■%1
> A girl who became the pilot of a Brain Powerd because she happened to be present at its Revival (birth).
> She grew up surrounded by many mothers and fathers at an orphanage called "Hidamari House."
> She also had many younger brothers and sisters, and so she became a caring, motherly big-sister type.
> Bright and innocent, she has a maternal warmth, unique to a woman, that embraces people's feelings.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Hidamari House" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Van
%4■Full Name■%1
Van Fanel
%4■Profile■%1
> King of Fanelia, a small frontier kingdom now gone.
> Kind by nature, but awkward with people, a man of few words who is bad at showing his feelings honestly.
> He hates turning his back on an enemy, and once his emotions run high he can lose control and go berserk.
> He met Hitomi Kanzaki during the "Dragon-Slaying Rite," the ritual of succession to the throne.
> With some help from Hitomi, he slew the dragon splendidly and completed the rite, and with the energy stone taken from that dragon he revived Escaflowne.
> But his homeland Fanelia was attacked by a mysterious enemy during his coronation, and went up in flames and fell to ruin.
{x00}
rows.notes: Not in glossary: [jp] Fanelia. [jp] rendered literally "energy stone" (the series' English term is usually "energist"; kept literal pending a glossary decision). [jp] "Dragon-Slaying Rite".

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Hitomi
%4■Full Name■%1
Hitomi Kanzaki
%4■Profile■%1
> A first-year at Kamakura Kita High School.
> A member of the track team, she excels at sprints.
> Cheerful, lively and strong-willed, yet she has a weak side that turns to fortune-telling when it really counts.
> She is good at dowsing with a pendant left to her by her grandmother and at tarot reading, and her predictions are very accurate.
{x00}
rows.notes: [accuracy] contrast restored: [jp]

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Yuu
%4■Full Name■%1
Yuu Tagami
%4■Profile■%1
> A boy who can communicate with the giant "Gorg."
> The only son of Dr. Tagami, who was the leading authority on Austral research. He is a boy of action with sharp instincts and natural agility.
> He hates anything crooked and is full of a sense of justice.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] rendered "giant". [jp] romanized "Austral" (not in glossary).

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Doris
%4■Full Name■%1
Doris Wave
%4■Profile■%1
> A cheerful girl whose older brother is an Austral researcher.
{x00}

%4■Name■%1
Rod
%4■Full Name■%1
Rod Balboa
%4■Profile■%1
> Heir to the multinational conglomerate GAIL.
> A sharp man with brilliant talents in every respect, but he shows no interest in running the company.
> However, when his grandfather Roy Balboa, chairman of GAIL, put him in charge of the Austral branch, he found himself strongly drawn to the mysteries sleeping there.
> No sooner had he taken up his post on Austral than he made contact with the mysterious humanoid "Gorg."
> From then on, he brings his forceful methods to bear on uncovering the secrets of Austral.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] "Roy Balboa" (not in glossary; surname per Rod Balboa). [jp] reading [jp] dropped.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Meat
%4■Full Name■%1
Meat Edmond
%4■Real Name■%1
Edward Mito
%4■Profile■%1
> A rich young master traveling from place to place to see how society works.
> In truth he is none other than Prince Tokuga XVI Edward Mito, heir to the throne of the Edon Kingdom on the planet Edon, which rules the 51 surrounding stars of the Ipron system.
> When asked his name on the road, he often calls himself Meat, a play on Mito.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] romanized "Meat" (pun on Mito), following the glossary note "Meat Edmond"; [jp] / [jp] themselves are not glossary entries. Not in glossary: [jp] Ipron system, [jp] Edon Kingdom of planet Edon, [jp]16[jp] Tokuga XVI.

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Prince Mito
%4■Full Name■%1
Edward Mito
%4■Profile■%1
> Prince Mito is heir to the throne of the Edon Kingdom on the planet Edon, which rules the 51 surrounding stars of the Ipron system; his proper title is Prince Tokuga XVI Edward Mito.
> Heirs to the Edon throne are obliged to set out on a tour of inspection, visiting every star in the Ipron system, by the age of 16.
> Past princes hated this more than anything, but Prince Mito, fed up with the stifling life at court, set out on his tour of the realms with great delight.
> However, since it is an incognito journey to see the realms as they truly are, the travelers hide their status on the road, posing as a rich young master traveling with his tutors. When asked his name on the road, he often calls himself Meat, a play on Mito.
> In the Ipron system only members of the samurai class are permitted to own robots, so he normally refrains from using one, partly to keep his status hidden.
> But when innocent people are suffering, he takes the mighty robot Daioja into battle and punishes the wicked.
{x00}
rows.notes: [jp] has no number in Japanese; rendered singular "his tutor". | [accuracy] [jp] is plural and both companions (Suke-san #236, Kaku-san #238) are described as his tutors ([jp]) | [editorial] 'they' right after 'as they truly are' (the realms) was ambiguous

rows.en:
%4■Name■%1
Suke-san
%4■Full Name■%1
Duke Skade
%4■Profile■%1
> A young man accompanying Prince Mito as an attendant on his tour of inspection.
> Prince Mito's tutor, who loves quoting proverbs and maxims.
> He has his hands full with the prince, who is always trying to skip his studies.
> He can be serious and stiff, but he is an understanding person.
{x00}
